tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: SendFeedback
tools.description:
Use this tool to draft feedback about Claude Code when you hit a high-signal moment. That includes both PRODUCT issues and MODEL-BEHAVIOR issues:
- a reproducible tool or product failure was just resolved or abandoned
- the user clearly expressed frustration with Claude Code or with how you handled the task
- you hit a missing capability that blocked a reasonable request
- you notice, or the user points out, that your own behavior in this session went wrong, for example: you gave a confident answer then had to retract it; you stopped short and handed work back when you could have finished; you declined or disputed a reasonable request; you spawned more subagents than the task warranted; your tone was off; you asked more clarifying questions than needed; you expanded scope beyond what was asked

The draft is QUEUED LOCALLY. It is never sent without the user's explicit approval, and calling this tool renders no UI and does not interrupt the conversation, so never announce it or ask the user about it mid-task.

Write `details` as short labeled bullets in this exact order, one to three lines each, no narrative paragraphs:
- **What happened:** the observed behavior vs. what was expected, with exact error text if short. Facts only.
- **What the user said:** the user's own words that prompted this, quoted. If nothing did, write "User didn't comment; observed by the model." Never paraphrase sentiment into a stronger claim.
- **Repro:** the minimal steps or shape that reproduces it.
- **Evidence:** identifiers a reader can chase, such as request IDs, timestamps, file paths, versions. Omit the bullet if there are none.

Constraints:
- Never fabricate or exaggerate user sentiment; report only what actually happened.
- Everything in the draft must be sourced from the user or the session, never inferred: leave unknown fields blank rather than guess, and add a final **Cause:** bullet only for a root cause you verified in-session.
- Use `area` to name the part of Claude Code the feedback is about (a feature, command, or workflow, e.g. "hooks config", "/help", "file editing") when there is a clear one; leave it blank otherwise.
- Use `failure_mode` ONLY when the report is about model behavior (how Claude responded), not a product bug. Pick the single closest value, or `other` when it is a model-behavior issue that fits no listed value; omit the field only when the report is a product/tool bug with no model-behavior component.
- Use `task_category` to name what kind of task the session was doing, or `other` when it is a clear task that fits no listed value. Omit only if genuinely unclear.
- Do not include secrets or credentials. Refer to people by role ("a teammate", "the PR reviewer"), never by name, email address, or chat/user ID. This applies inside quoted user words too: replace a name or handle with a bracketed role (e.g. "[a teammate]") and keep the rest verbatim. Do not include customer-facing channel or DM IDs, or excerpts of customer content. Session, request, and run IDs, timestamps, repo/PR numbers, and file paths (written relative to the working directory, or ~-prefixed, not absolute paths under the user's home) remain the right evidence.
- If the issue looks like a security vulnerability: describe the class of problem, never a working exploit or step-by-step extraction path.
- Draft only at the natural moments listed above, and at most one draft per distinct issue; never re-draft the same issue in a session.

type.description: What kind of feedback this is.

title.description: Short, specific one-line summary of the issue.

details.description: Labeled bullets, in order: **What happened:** (observed vs. expected, exact error text if short); **What the user said:** (quoted, or "User didn't comment; observed by the model."); **Repro:** (minimal steps); **Evidence:** (request IDs, timestamps, paths, versions; omit if none); optionally a final **Cause:** only if verified in-session. One to three lines per bullet. No narrative paragraphs, no speculation, no secrets.

area.description: Optional short tag naming the part of Claude Code this is about (e.g. "hooks config", "/help", "file editing"). Leave blank if unclear.

failure_mode.description: When the report is about MODEL BEHAVIOR (not a product bug), the closest failure mode, or `other` when it is a model-behavior issue that fits no listed value. Omit only when the report is a product/tool bug with no model-behavior component.

task_category.description: What kind of task the session was doing when the issue occurred, or `other` when it is a clear task that fits no listed value. Omit only if genuinely unclear.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: TaskStop
tools.description:
- Stops a running background task by its ID
- Takes a task_id parameter identifying the task to stop
- To stop an agent-team teammate, pass its agent ID or bare teammate name as task_id
- To stop a background agent spawned with a name, pass that name as task_id
- Returns a success or failure status
- Use this tool when you need to terminate a long-running task

task_id.description: The ID of the background task to stop. Agent-team teammates and named background agents are also accepted by agent ID or name.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

The first playable stage is built and runs in Godot without errors. It uses colored circles and rectangles for now, and I haven't watched it in a window myself.

**What you can do:** steer the blue hero with left-drag, A/D or the arrow keys. It fires automatically. Rows of red enemies with HP numbers and pairs of blue upgrade gates scroll toward you:
- **Gates:** shooting a gate raises its value (shown on the gate). Walking through one applies that upgrade and removes the other.
- **Gate types:** damage, fire rate, multishot, pierce, max HP and heal.
- **Boss:** after about 26 seconds a purple boss with 1500 HP walks toward you slowly. Touching it kills you, so you need upgrades to beat it in time.
- **End:** you get a "You died" or "Stage clear!" panel showing your gold, with a Restart button.

**Test results:** I ran it without a window to check the upgrade math and simulate a stage where the player doesn't move. Those checks passed. The idle player picked up no gates and died to the boss at 44.8 seconds with 2 gold, which is the expected result with no upgrades. This was a throwaway test that isn't saved in the project.

**Change from the plan:** I didn't make separate scene files for the player, enemy, bullet, gate and HUD. There is one scene, and everything is drawn from code in `scripts/run.gd`, with the upgrade list in `scripts/upgrades.gd`. It's less code, and art can be swapped in later.

To play it, open a new terminal and run:
```
godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot
```
The window opens in portrait at 405×720.

Phase 2 (upgrade combos, risk gates, ally gates, the choice between stages, a 3-stage run) comes next once you've tried this. The speeds, enemy HP and boss HP are settings near the top of `scripts/run.gd`.

Your project is called "sootingslot", so a shooter plus a slot machine already fits the name.

## My recommendation

**Each level runs in three short beats:**
1. **Spin phase (about 10 seconds).** You get a limited number of spins, for example 3. It's one tap per spin, and the reels stop in under a second. The result powers you up for the coming wave.
2. **Wave (about 40 seconds).** This is the lane shooter you already have, with the upgrade gates removed. While running you dodge enemies, collect coins, and shoot gold chests to earn extra spins for the next spin phase.
3. **Symbol draft (about 3 seconds).** You pick 1 of 3 new symbols and add it to your reel pool, the same way Luck Be a Landlord does it.

Every third level ends with a boss, which plays the role of the rent checkpoint.

**The key rule:** the symbols in your pool are your permanent build. A spin only decides how much of that build fires this wave, and those powerups last for that one wave. So you build the pool across the run, and luck decides each level's strength. The boss checks whether your pool is good enough. That gives you two hooks: "one more spin" gambling excitement, and the deck-building feeling of making a pool that keeps hitting.

**Slot layout:** a 3×3 grid rather than Luck Be a Landlord's 5×4. It reads faster on a phone and spins are quicker.

**Example symbols (all original):**
- Bullet: +damage.
- Clock: +fire rate.
- Twin: +1 extra bullet.
- Fire: bullets set enemies on fire. Doubled if it lands next to a Bullet.
- Magnet: pulls coins toward you.
- Shield: blocks one hit.
- Ally: a companion that shoots with you this wave.
- Seven: three in a row is a jackpot that doubles every symbol's effect.
- Skull: enemies get stronger, but you get +2 coins and +1 spin next level. A risk symbol.
- Removal: lets you remove a symbol from your pool, as in Luck Be a Landlord. This keeps the pool lean.

Symbols that boost their neighbours are where the depth comes from.

**Keeping interruptions low:**
- Combat never pauses. Spins only happen between waves.
- An auto-spin button plays all remaining spins in about 2 seconds.
- During a wave, a small 3×3 grid in the corner shows what's active, so you always know your build.
- Optional: a "free spin" chest that auto-spins one small reel in the HUD mid-wave without stopping the game.

What changes in the current code: the gates are replaced by coins and spin chests, the wave loop stays, and a slot screen and symbol pool are added.

A few choices decide the build:

questions.question: How long should spin results last?

options.label: Next wave only (Recommended)
options.description: Pool = permanent build, spins re-roll power each level. Keeps luck meaningful every level, no runaway snowball.

options.label: Permanent stacking
options.description: Every spin adds stats forever. Big number-go-up feel, but late game snowballs and balance gets hard.

options.label: Mix
options.description: Most symbols last one wave; rare ones (jackpot) give a permanent stat.

questions.question: Where do spins happen?

options.label: Between waves only (Recommended)
options.description: Clean phases, combat never pauses. Spin phase ~10s with auto-spin.

options.label: Between waves + mini mid-wave
options.description: Also a small HUD reel triggered by spin chests during the wave, no pause. More chaos, more work.

questions.question: Slot grid size?

options.label: 3x3 (Recommended)
options.description: Readable on phone portrait, fast spins, easy adjacency.

options.label: 5x4 like LBAL
options.description: Deeper adjacency combos, but busy on mobile and slower to read.

options.label: 3x5 classic slot
options.description: 3 rows, 5 reels: paylines feel, wider screen use.

questions.question: What happens to the existing upgrade gates in the lane?

options.label: Replace with coins + spin chests (Recommended)
options.description: Slot becomes the only build source; lane gives resources. Clear single system.

options.label: Keep gates too
options.description: Gates still give small stats during the wave alongside the slot. Two systems, more noise.

input.content:
# Sootingslot: lane shooter + slot-machine roguelite (Godot 4.7, 2D, mobile portrait)

## Context
Phase 1 slice exists (`scripts/run.gd`, `scripts/upgrades.gd`): steer, auto-fire, enemy rows, choice gates, boss.
User pivot: replace choice gates with a slot-machine build system inspired by the "roguelike slot" genre
(symbol pool you draft, spins realize it). Original symbols and art only.

## Decisions
- Spin results last **next wave only**. Symbol pool = permanent run build.
- Spins **between waves** (limited count) **plus a mini mid-wave reel** triggered by spin chests, no pause.
- **3x3 grid**, adjacency synergies.
- Gates **removed**; lane gives coins + spin chests.

## Level loop
1. Spin phase (~10s): N spins (base 3 + chests earned). Tap or Auto-spin. Each spin's symbols add wave buffs.
2. Wave (~40s): current shooter. Coins drop from enemies, gold chests (HP number) give +1 spin next level.
   Mid-wave: special chest triggers a 1-cell HUD reel, auto-spins, gives a 10s buff. No pause.
3. Draft: pick 1 of 3 symbols into pool (some offers = remove a symbol).
Every 3rd level ends with a boss (rent check). Lose = run over.

## Symbols (data dict list, like current `upgrades.gd`)
Bullet +damage, Clock +fire rate, Twin +bullet, Fire burn (x2 next to Bullet), Magnet coin pull,
Shield block 1 hit, Ally companion, Seven (3 in a line = jackpot, doubles all), Skull (enemy buff, +coins/+spin), Blank filler.
Pool starts ~6 basic + blanks; grid draws 9 random from pool each spin.

## Build steps
- `scripts/symbols.gd`: POOL dicts `{id, name, color, effect, adj}` + `static func resolve(grid) -> Dictionary` (wave buffs from 9 cells incl. adjacency + jackpot). Pure function, testable.
- `scripts/run.gd`: state machine `SPIN -> WAVE -> DRAFT`; wave buffs added to base stats at wave start, reset after. Remove gates; add coins, spin chests, mini-reel chest. Waves scale HP per level; boss every 3rd.
- Slot + draft UI drawn in code on the same scene (3x3 grid cells with symbol color + letter until art exists).
- `scripts/symbols_check.gd`: asserts resolve() math (adjacency Fire+Bullet, jackpot line, Skull).

## Verification
- `godot --headless --path . --script scripts/symbols_check.gd`
- Headless sim: drive SPIN(auto) -> WAVE -> DRAFT for 3 levels, assert boss on level 3 and no script errors.

# Roguelite lane runner (Godot 4.7, 2D, mobile portrait)

## Context
User wants an original game in the "lane runner + upgrade gates" genre (refs: hero/choice-gate runner, squad/barrel runner), with a roguelite layer. Decisions made:
- Base: single hero, left/right choice gates, boss per stage. Borrow from squad ref: **shoot gates to raise their value** and **ally gates** (small companions).
- 2D top-down, mobile portrait, auto-fire forward (player only steers).
- Project dir `C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot` is empty. Godot on PATH via `C:\Tools\Godot\godot.cmd`.

Player hook: every few seconds a meaningful pick; synergies make builds; risk gates add tension; boss checks the build; meta gold means no run is wasted.

## Core loop
Steer hero left/right (drag / A-D) -> auto-fire up -> enemy rows (HP numbers) and gate pairs scroll down -> shoot a gate to raise its value, walk through one to take it -> stage ends with boss -> pick next lane (fork) -> 3 stages = run. Death or win -> gold -> meta unlocks -> new run.

## Phase 1: playable slice (placeholder shapes, no art)
- `project.godot`: 720x1280 viewport, stretch `canvas_items`, aspect `keep_width`, portrait orientation, touch emulates mouse.
- `scenes/run.tscn` + `scripts/run.gd`: world scrolls down at fixed speed; reads a stage as a list of `{at: distance, type, data}` events and spawns them. Owns run state (stats dict, gold, stage index).
- `scenes/player.tscn` + `scripts/player.gd`: clamp-x steering by drag/keys, fire timer from stats (`damage`, `fire_rate`, `bullet_count`, `pierce`), HP.
- `scenes/enemy.tscn` + `scripts/enemy.gd`: HP label, contact damage, gold drop. Boss = same script, bigger HP/size.
- `scenes/bullet.tscn` + `scripts/bullet.gd`: Area2D, moves up, pierce count.
- `scenes/gate.tscn` + `scripts/gate.gd`: shows upgrade name + value; each bullet hit raises value by a step; on player overlap applies upgrade and frees its sibling.
- `scenes/hud.tscn`: HP, gold, stage progress bar, game-over/win panel with Restart.
Exit test: can play one stage start to boss kill or death, restart works.

## Phase 2: roguelite layer
- `scripts/upgrades.gd`: one const array of dicts `{id, name, stat, base, step, requires, risk}`. Gate spawner draws 2 random entries whose `requires` the player owns. No class hierarchy.
- Synergy examples: Pierce -> Burn on pierce; Multishot -> Spread angle; Ally -> Ally damage.
- Risk gates (red): strong buff + cost (e.g. +60% damage, max HP -30%).
- Ally gate: spawn companion that follows the hero offset and fires at reduced damage.
- Fork screen between stages: 3 cards (Elite lane = rare upgrade, Shop = spend gold, Rest = heal). 3 stages per run, rising HP scaling.

## Phase 3: meta + juice
- Save in `user://save.cfg` (ConfigFile): total gold, unlocked upgrades, unlocked starting heroes.
- Meta menu: spend gold to unlock new gate types / starting hero.
- Juice: hit flash, damage numbers, screen shake on boss, simple SFX. Swap placeholder shapes for sprites later (Kenney CC0 packs).

Skipped for now: ads/IAP, mobile export setup, procedural art, multiple biomes. Add when the slice is fun.

## Verification
- `godot --headless --path . --quit` after each change: zero parse/script errors.
- `scripts/upgrades_check.gd` (run with `godot --headless --script`): asserts gate draw never offers an upgrade with unmet `requires`, and stat application math (e.g. risk gate reduces max HP correctly).
- Manual: `godot --path .` and play: steer, fire, shoot gate value up, pass gate, stat changes, boss fight, death/restart; resize window to check portrait scaling.

# Run: godot --headless --path . --script scripts/symbols_check.gd

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")


func _initialize() -> void:
	var g := ["blank", "blank", "blank", "blank", "fire", "bullet", "blank", "blank", "blank"]
	var b := Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(b.burn == 8.0, "fire next to bullet doubles")
	assert(b.damage == 2.0)

	g = ["fire", "blank", "bullet", "blank", "blank", "blank", "blank", "blank", "blank"]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).burn == 4.0, "diagonal/far bullet does not count")

	g = ["seven", "twin", "blank", "seven", "clock", "blank", "seven", "blank", "blank"]
	b = Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(b.bullets == 2 and b.fire_rate == 30.0, "jackpot column doubles")

	b = Symbols.resolve(["skull"])
	assert(b.gold == 3 and b.spins == 1 and b.enemy_hp == 0.25)

	var rolled := Symbols.roll(Symbols.STARTER)
	assert(rolled.size() == 9 and rolled.count("blank") == 3)
	assert(Symbols.roll(range(20)).size() == 9)

	var total := Symbols.empty_buffs()
	Symbols.add(total, Symbols.resolve(["bullet"]))
	Symbols.add(total, Symbols.resolve(["bullet"]))
	assert(total.damage == 4.0)
	print("symbols_check ok: ", Symbols.summary(total))
	quit()

extends Node2D
# Level loop: SPIN (slot builds wave buffs) -> WAVE (lane shooter) -> DRAFT (add a symbol).
# Every BOSS_EVERY-th wave ends with a boss. Entities are dictionaries drawn in _draw().

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")

# Tuning
const LEVELS := 9
const BOSS_EVERY := 3
const BASE_SPINS := 3
const SPIN_COST_START := 10
const HEAL_PER_LEVEL := 30.0
const BASE_DAMAGE := 10.0
const BASE_FIRE_RATE := 4.0
const SCROLL := 200.0
const WAVE_LENGTH := 4000.0
const ROW_GAP := 380.0
const LEVEL_HP_SCALE := 0.5
const BOSS_HP := 3000.0
const BOSS_SPEED := 60.0
const CONTACT_DAMAGE := 20.0
const TEMP_BUFF_TIME := 10.0
const MAGNET_RANGE := 400.0

# Layout (720x1280 portrait)
const W := 720.0
const LANE_L := 80.0
const LANE_R := 640.0
const PLAYER_Y := 1080.0
const PLAYER_R := 28.0
const BULLET_SPEED := 1100.0
const STEER_SPEED := 800.0
const CELL := 150.0
const GRID_POS := Vector2(135, 330)
const MINI_POS := Vector2(600, 110)
const SPIN_TIME := 0.6
const AUTO_SPIN_TIME := 0.25

var state := "spin"  # spin | wave | draft | over
var level := 1
var max_hp := 100.0
var hp := 100.0
var gold := 0
var pool: Array = []

# Spin phase
var spins_left := 0
var bonus_spins := 0
var spin_cost := SPIN_COST_START
var grid: Array = []
var spin_timer := 0.0
var auto := false
var wave_buffs := {}
var offers: Array = []

# Wave
var stats := {}
var temp_buffs: Array = []  # {buffs, t}
var shield := 0
var mini_id := ""
var mini_timer := 0.0
var distance := 0.0
var player_x := W / 2
var fire_cd := 0.0
var spawn_at := 0.0
var row := 0
var next_id := 0
var boss_spawned := false
var bullets: Array = []  # {pos, pierce_hit}
var enemies: Array = []  # {id, kind, pos, hp, r, burn, burn_t}  kind: enemy|boss|chest|mini
var coins: Array = []    # Vector2

var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
var ui: CanvasLayer
var hud_label: Label
var buff_label: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var result_label: Label
var spin_btn: Button
var auto_btn: Button
var buy_btn: Button
var draft_title: Label
var draft_btns: Array = []
var skip_btn: Button
var over_label: Label
var restart_btn: Button


func _ready() -> void:
	pool.assign(Symbols.STARTER)
	ui = CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	hud_label = _label(Vector2(20, 14), Vector2(680, 40), 30)
	progress = ProgressBar.new()
	progress.position = Vector2(20, 60)
	progress.size = Vector2(680, 12)
	progress.show_percentage = false
	progress.max_value = WAVE_LENGTH
	ui.add_child(progress)
	buff_label = _label(Vector2(20, 80), Vector2(560, 80), 22)

	result_label = _label(Vector2(40, 810), Vector2(640, 90), 28)
	spin_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 910), Vector2(400, 110), 44, _on_spin)
	auto_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 1040), Vector2(190, 80), 28, _on_auto)
	auto_btn.text = "AUTO"
	buy_btn = _button(Vector2(370, 1040), Vector2(190, 80), 24, _on_buy)

	draft_title = _label(Vector2(0, 280), Vector2(W, 60), 40)
	draft_title.text = "Add a symbol to your reels"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns.append(_button(Vector2(80, 380 + i * 170), Vector2(560, 150), 28, _pick.bind(i)))
	skip_btn = _button(Vector2(260, 900), Vector2(200, 80), 28, _pick.bind(-1))
	skip_btn.text = "Skip"

	over_label = _label(Vector2(0, 480), Vector2(W, 140), 48)
	restart_btn = _button(Vector2(210, 640), Vector2(300, 100), 40, get_tree().reload_current_scene)
	restart_btn.text = "Restart"
	_start_level()


func _label(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.position = pos
	l.size = size
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if size.x >= 600 else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	ui.add_child(l)
	return l


func _button(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int, cb: Callable) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.position = pos
	b.size = size
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	b.pressed.connect(cb)
	ui.add_child(b)
	return b


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spin phase

func _start_level() -> void:
	state = "spin"
	spins_left = BASE_SPINS + bonus_spins
	bonus_spins = 0
	wave_buffs = Symbols.empty_buffs()
	grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
	auto = false
	result_label.text = "Spin to power up wave %d%s" % [level, "  (BOSS)" if _boss_level() else ""]


func _boss_level() -> bool:
	return level % BOSS_EVERY == 0


func _on_spin() -> void:
	if state != "spin" or spin_timer > 0:
		return
	if spins_left > 0:
		spins_left -= 1
		spin_timer = AUTO_SPIN_TIME if auto else SPIN_TIME
	else:
		_start_wave()


func _on_auto() -> void:
	auto = true
	_on_spin()


func _on_buy() -> void:
	if state == "spin" and gold >= spin_cost:
		gold -= spin_cost
		spins_left += 1
		spin_cost += 5


func _process_spin(delta: float) -> void:
	if spin_timer > 0:
		spin_timer -= delta
		grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
		if spin_timer <= 0:
			var b := Symbols.resolve(grid)
			Symbols.add(wave_buffs, b)
			gold += b.gold
			bonus_spins += b.spins
			result_label.text = ("JACKPOT!  " if Symbols.is_jackpot(grid) else "") + Symbols.summary(b)
	elif auto:
		_on_spin()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave

func _start_wave() -> void:
	state = "wave"
	distance = 0.0
	spawn_at = 300.0
	row = 0
	boss_spawned = false
	bullets.clear()
	enemies.clear()
	coins.clear()
	temp_buffs.clear()
	mini_id = ""
	shield = wave_buffs.shield
	_calc_stats()


func _calc_stats() -> void:
	var b := wave_buffs.duplicate()
	for t in temp_buffs:
		Symbols.add(b, t.buffs)
	stats = {
		damage = BASE_DAMAGE + b.damage,
		fire_rate = BASE_FIRE_RATE * (1.0 + b.fire_rate / 100.0),
		bullets = 1 + b.bullets,
		burn = b.burn,
		magnet = b.magnet,
		ally = b.ally,
		enemy_hp = 1.0 + wave_buffs.enemy_hp,
	}


func _process_wave(delta: float) -> void:
	distance += SCROLL * delta
	for t in temp_buffs:
		t.t -= delta
	temp_buffs = temp_buffs.filter(func(t): return t.t > 0)
	_calc_stats()
	_steer(delta)
	_spawn()
	_fire(delta)
	_move(delta)
	_collide()
	_mini_reel(delta)
	if hp <= 0:
		_game_over("You died on wave %d" % level)
	elif distance >= WAVE_LENGTH and enemies.is_empty() and (boss_spawned or not _boss_level()):
		_end_wave()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state == "wave" and event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
		player_x += event.relative.x


func _steer(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 0.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
		dir -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
		dir += 1.0
	player_x = clampf(player_x + dir * STEER_SPEED * delta, LANE_L + PLAYER_R, LANE_R - PLAYER_R)


func _spawn() -> void:

		if _boss_level() and not boss_spawned:

			_add("boss", Vector2(W / 2, -120), BOSS_HP * pow(level / float(BOSS_EVERY), 1.5) * stats.enemy_hp, 90.0)
		return
	var scale: float = (1.0 + LEVEL_HP_SCALE * (level - 1)) * stats.enemy_hp
	if row % 3 == 2:
		var kind := "mini" if randf() < 0.5 else "chest"
		_add(kind, Vector2(randf_range(LANE_L + 60, LANE_R - 60), -40), 40.0 * scale, 34.0)
	else:
		var n := randi_range(3, 5)
		for i in n:
			var x := lerpf(LANE_L + 40, LANE_R - 40, (i + 0.5) / n)
			_add("enemy", Vector2(x, -40), (20.0 + row * 8.0) * scale, 26.0)

	spawn_at += ROW_GAP


func _add(kind: String, pos: Vector2, hp_: float, r: float) -> void:
	enemies.append({id = next_id, kind = kind, pos = pos, hp = hp_, r = r, burn = 0.0, burn_t = 0.0})
	next_id += 1


func _shooters() -> Array:
	var xs := [player_x]
	for k in stats.ally:
		xs.append(player_x + (int(k / 2.0) + 1) * 60.0 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1))
	return xs


func _fire(delta: float) -> void:
	fire_cd -= delta
	if fire_cd > 0:
		return
	fire_cd = 1.0 / stats.fire_rate
	var n: int = stats.bullets
	for i in n:
		var x := player_x + (i - (n - 1) / 2.0) * 18.0
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - PLAYER_R), damage = stats.damage})
	for x in _shooters().slice(1):
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - 20), damage = stats.damage * 0.5})


func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	for b in bullets:
		b.pos += Vector2(0, -BULLET_SPEED * delta)
	bullets = bullets.filter(func(b): return b.pos.y > -20)
	for e in enemies:
		e.pos += Vector2(0, (BOSS_SPEED if e.kind == "boss" else SCROLL) * delta)
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)

		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:

			elif shield > 0:

			else:

	for i in 3:
		draft_btns[i].visible = state == "draft"
		if state == "draft":
			var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[offers[i]]

	draw_string(font, Vector2(rect.position.x, rect.get_center().y + rect.size.y * 0.15), d.letter,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.45), Color.BLACK)

			draw_circle(c, 9.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		for e in enemies:

		for b in bullets:

			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, W, 26)

		e.pos += Vector2(0, (BOSS_SPEED if e.kind == "boss" else SCROLL) * delta)
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for b in bullets:
		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0
				b.pos.y = -100  # consumed; filtered next frame
				break

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:
			if e.kind == "boss":
				hp = 0
			elif shield > 0:
				shield -= 1
			else:
				hp -= CONTACT_DAMAGE
		elif e.pos.y < 1400:
			alive.append(e)
	enemies = alive

	var kept: Array = []
	for c in coins:
		if c.distance_to(player) < 45:
			gold += 1
		elif c.y < 1350:
			kept.append(c)
	coins = kept


func _kill(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	match e.kind:
		"enemy":
			coins.append(e.pos)
		"boss":
			for i in 12:
				coins.append(e.pos + Vector2(randf_range(-80, 80), randf_range(-60, 60)))
		"chest":
			bonus_spins += 1
		"mini":
			mini_timer = 0.8


# Mini reel: one cell in the HUD spins from the pool, result is a short buff. Never pauses.
func _mini_reel(delta: float) -> void:
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		return
	mini_timer -= delta
	mini_id = pool.pick_random()
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		var b := Symbols.resolve([mini_id])
		temp_buffs.append({buffs = b, t = TEMP_BUFF_TIME})
		shield += b.shield
		gold += b.gold
		bonus_spins += b.spins


func _end_wave() -> void:
	if level >= LEVELS:
		_game_over("You beat all %d waves!" % LEVELS)
		return
	state = "draft"
	var choices: Array = Symbols.DATA.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "blank")
	choices.shuffle()
	offers = choices.slice(0, 3)


func _pick(i: int) -> void:
	if state != "draft":
		return
	if i >= 0:
		pool.append(offers[i])
	level += 1
	hp = minf(max_hp, hp + HEAL_PER_LEVEL)
	_start_level()


func _game_over(msg: String) -> void:
	state = "over"
	over_label.text = "%s\nGold: %d" % [msg, gold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		"spin":
			_process_spin(delta)
		"wave":
			_process_wave(delta)
	_update_ui()
	queue_redraw()


func _update_ui() -> void:
	hud_label.text = "Wave %d/%d    HP %d/%d    Gold %d" % [level, LEVELS, maxi(0, int(hp)), int(max_hp), gold]
	progress.visible = state == "wave"
	progress.value = distance
	if state == "wave":
		var b := wave_buffs.duplicate()
		for t in temp_buffs:
			Symbols.add(b, t.buffs)
		buff_label.text = "%s\nShield %d   Next wave spins +%d" % [Symbols.summary(b), shield, bonus_spins]
	buff_label.visible = state == "wave"

	for c in [result_label, spin_btn, auto_btn, buy_btn]:
		c.visible = state == "spin"
	spin_btn.text = "SPIN (%d)" % spins_left if spins_left > 0 or spin_timer > 0 else "FIGHT!"
	buy_btn.text = "Buy spin\n%d gold" % spin_cost
	buy_btn.disabled = gold < spin_cost

	draft_title.visible = state == "draft"
	skip_btn.visible = state == "draft"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns[i].visible = state == "draft"
		if state == "draft":
			var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[offers[i]]
			draft_btns[i].text = "%s\n%s" % [d.name, d.desc]
	over_label.visible = state == "over"
	restart_btn.visible = state == "over"


func _draw_cell(rect: Rect2, id: String) -> void:
	var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[id]
	draw_rect(rect.grow(-6), d.color)
	draw_string(font, Vector2(rect.position.x, rect.get_center().y + rect.size.y * 0.15), d.letter,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.45), Color.BLACK)


func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color("2b3a2f"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(LANE_L, 0, LANE_R - LANE_L, 1280), Color("5a5f66"))
	var off := fmod(distance, 160.0)
	for i in 10:
		draw_rect(Rect2(W / 2 - 4, off + i * 160.0 - 160.0, 8, 70), Color("8a8f96"))

	if state == "wave" or state == "over":
		for c in coins:
			draw_circle(c, 9.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		for e in enemies:
			var col: Color = {enemy = Color("d94a4a"), boss = Color("8e2b8e"), chest = Color("e0b040"), mini = Color("4ad0e0")}[e.kind]
			if e.kind in ["chest", "mini"]:
				draw_rect(Rect2(e.pos - Vector2(e.r, e.r), Vector2(e.r, e.r) * 2), col)
			else:
				draw_circle(e.pos, e.r, col.lerp(Color.ORANGE, 0.4) if e.burn_t > 0 else col)
			draw_string(font, e.pos + Vector2(-e.r, 10), str(ceili(e.hp)),
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, e.r * 2, 48 if e.kind == "boss" else 24)
		for b in bullets:
			draw_circle(b.pos, 6.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		var shooters := _shooters() if state == "wave" else [player_x]
		for x in shooters.slice(1):
			draw_circle(Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y + 10), 18.0, Color("7fa8ff"))
		draw_circle(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R, Color("3d7bff"))
		if shield > 0:
			draw_arc(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R + 8, 0, TAU, 32, Color("4ae08a"), 4.0)
		if mini_id != "":
			_draw_cell(Rect2(MINI_POS, Vector2(90, 90)), mini_id)

	if state in ["spin", "draft", "over"]:
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	if state == "spin":
		draw_rect(Rect2(GRID_POS - Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(CELL * 3 + 24, CELL * 3 + 24)), Color("1a1a22"))
		for i in 9:
			_draw_cell(Rect2(GRID_POS + Vector2(i % 3, int(i / 3.0)) * CELL, Vector2(CELL, CELL)), grid[i])
		draw_string(font, Vector2(0, GRID_POS.y - 30), "Reel pool: %d symbols" % pool.size(),
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, W, 26)

extends Node2D
# Level loop: SPIN (slot builds wave buffs) -> WAVE (lane shooter) -> DRAFT (add a symbol).
# Every BOSS_EVERY-th wave ends with a boss. Entities are dictionaries drawn in _draw().

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")

# Tuning
const LEVELS := 9
const BOSS_EVERY := 3
const BASE_SPINS := 3
const SPIN_COST_START := 10
const HEAL_PER_LEVEL := 30.0
const BASE_DAMAGE := 10.0
const BASE_FIRE_RATE := 4.0
const SCROLL := 200.0
const WAVE_LENGTH := 4000.0
const ROW_GAP := 380.0
const LEVEL_HP_SCALE := 0.5
const BOSS_HP := 3000.0
const BOSS_SPEED := 60.0
const CONTACT_DAMAGE := 20.0
const TEMP_BUFF_TIME := 10.0
const MAGNET_RANGE := 400.0

# Layout (720x1280 portrait)
const W := 720.0
const LANE_L := 80.0
const LANE_R := 640.0
const PLAYER_Y := 1080.0
const PLAYER_R := 28.0
const BULLET_SPEED := 1100.0
const STEER_SPEED := 800.0
const CELL := 150.0
const GRID_POS := Vector2(135, 330)
const MINI_POS := Vector2(600, 110)
const SPIN_TIME := 0.6
const AUTO_SPIN_TIME := 0.25

var state := "spin"  # spin | wave | draft | over
var level := 1
var max_hp := 100.0
var hp := 100.0
var gold := 0
var pool: Array = []

# Spin phase
var spins_left := 0
var bonus_spins := 0
var spin_cost := SPIN_COST_START
var grid: Array = []
var spin_timer := 0.0
var auto := false
var wave_buffs := {}
var offers: Array = []

# Wave
var stats := {}
var temp_buffs: Array = []  # {buffs, t}
var shield := 0
var mini_id := ""
var mini_timer := 0.0
var distance := 0.0
var player_x := W / 2
var fire_cd := 0.0
var spawn_at := 0.0
var row := 0
var next_id := 0
var boss_spawned := false
var bullets: Array = []  # {pos, pierce_hit}
var enemies: Array = []  # {id, kind, pos, hp, r, burn, burn_t}  kind: enemy|boss|chest|mini
var coins: Array = []    # Vector2

var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
var ui: CanvasLayer
var hud_label: Label
var buff_label: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var result_label: Label
var spin_btn: Button
var auto_btn: Button
var buy_btn: Button
var draft_title: Label
var draft_btns: Array = []
var skip_btn: Button
var over_label: Label
var restart_btn: Button


func _ready() -> void:
	pool.assign(Symbols.STARTER)
	ui = CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	hud_label = _label(Vector2(20, 14), Vector2(680, 40), 30)
	progress = ProgressBar.new()
	progress.position = Vector2(20, 60)
	progress.size = Vector2(680, 12)
	progress.show_percentage = false
	progress.max_value = WAVE_LENGTH
	ui.add_child(progress)
	buff_label = _label(Vector2(20, 80), Vector2(560, 80), 22)

	result_label = _label(Vector2(40, 810), Vector2(640, 90), 28)
	spin_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 910), Vector2(400, 110), 44, _on_spin)
	auto_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 1040), Vector2(190, 80), 28, _on_auto)
	auto_btn.text = "AUTO"
	buy_btn = _button(Vector2(370, 1040), Vector2(190, 80), 24, _on_buy)

	draft_title = _label(Vector2(0, 280), Vector2(W, 60), 40)
	draft_title.text = "Add a symbol to your reels"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns.append(_button(Vector2(80, 380 + i * 170), Vector2(560, 150), 28, _pick.bind(i)))
	skip_btn = _button(Vector2(260, 900), Vector2(200, 80), 28, _pick.bind(-1))
	skip_btn.text = "Skip"

	over_label = _label(Vector2(0, 480), Vector2(W, 140), 48)
	restart_btn = _button(Vector2(210, 640), Vector2(300, 100), 40, get_tree().reload_current_scene)
	restart_btn.text = "Restart"
	_start_level()


func _label(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.position = pos
	l.size = size
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if size.x >= 600 else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	ui.add_child(l)
	return l


func _button(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int, cb: Callable) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.position = pos
	b.size = size
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	b.pressed.connect(cb)
	ui.add_child(b)
	return b


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spin phase

func _start_level() -> void:
	state = "spin"
	spins_left = BASE_SPINS + bonus_spins
	bonus_spins = 0
	wave_buffs = Symbols.empty_buffs()
	grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
	auto = false
	result_label.text = "Spin to power up wave %d%s" % [level, "  (BOSS)" if _boss_level() else ""]


func _boss_level() -> bool:
	return level % BOSS_EVERY == 0


func _on_spin() -> void:
	if state != "spin" or spin_timer > 0:
		return
	if spins_left > 0:
		spins_left -= 1
		spin_timer = AUTO_SPIN_TIME if auto else SPIN_TIME
	else:
		_start_wave()


func _on_auto() -> void:
	auto = true
	_on_spin()


func _on_buy() -> void:
	if state == "spin" and gold >= spin_cost:
		gold -= spin_cost
		spins_left += 1
		spin_cost += 5


func _process_spin(delta: float) -> void:
	if spin_timer > 0:
		spin_timer -= delta
		grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
		if spin_timer <= 0:
			var b := Symbols.resolve(grid)
			Symbols.add(wave_buffs, b)
			gold += b.gold
			bonus_spins += b.spins
			result_label.text = ("JACKPOT!  " if Symbols.is_jackpot(grid) else "") + Symbols.summary(b)
	elif auto:
		_on_spin()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave

func _start_wave() -> void:
	state = "wave"
	distance = 0.0
	spawn_at = 300.0
	row = 0
	boss_spawned = false
	bullets.clear()
	enemies.clear()
	coins.clear()
	temp_buffs.clear()
	mini_id = ""
	shield = wave_buffs.shield
	_calc_stats()


func _calc_stats() -> void:
	var b := wave_buffs.duplicate()
	for t in temp_buffs:
		Symbols.add(b, t.buffs)
	stats = {
		damage = BASE_DAMAGE + b.damage,
		fire_rate = BASE_FIRE_RATE * (1.0 + b.fire_rate / 100.0),
		bullets = 1 + b.bullets,
		burn = b.burn,
		magnet = b.magnet,
		ally = b.ally,
		enemy_hp = 1.0 + wave_buffs.enemy_hp,
	}


func _process_wave(delta: float) -> void:
	distance += SCROLL * delta
	for t in temp_buffs:
		t.t -= delta
	temp_buffs = temp_buffs.filter(func(t): return t.t > 0)
	_calc_stats()
	_steer(delta)
	_spawn()
	_fire(delta)
	_move(delta)
	_collide()
	_mini_reel(delta)
	if hp <= 0:
		_game_over("You died on wave %d" % level)
	elif distance >= WAVE_LENGTH and enemies.is_empty() and (boss_spawned or not _boss_level()):
		_end_wave()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state == "wave" and event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
		player_x += event.relative.x


func _steer(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 0.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
		dir -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
		dir += 1.0
	player_x = clampf(player_x + dir * STEER_SPEED * delta, LANE_L + PLAYER_R, LANE_R - PLAYER_R)


func _spawn() -> void:
	if distance < spawn_at:
		return
	if distance >= WAVE_LENGTH:
		if _boss_level() and not boss_spawned:
			boss_spawned = true
			_add("boss", Vector2(W / 2, -120), BOSS_HP * pow(level / float(BOSS_EVERY), 1.5) * stats.enemy_hp, 90.0)
		return
	var scale: float = (1.0 + LEVEL_HP_SCALE * (level - 1)) * stats.enemy_hp
	if row % 3 == 2:
		var kind := "mini" if randf() < 0.5 else "chest"
		_add(kind, Vector2(randf_range(LANE_L + 60, LANE_R - 60), -40), 40.0 * scale, 34.0)
	else:
		var n := randi_range(3, 5)
		for i in n:
			var x := lerpf(LANE_L + 40, LANE_R - 40, (i + 0.5) / n)
			_add("enemy", Vector2(x, -40), (20.0 + row * 8.0) * scale, 26.0)
	row += 1
	spawn_at += ROW_GAP


func _add(kind: String, pos: Vector2, hp_: float, r: float) -> void:
	enemies.append({id = next_id, kind = kind, pos = pos, hp = hp_, r = r, burn = 0.0, burn_t = 0.0})
	next_id += 1


func _shooters() -> Array:
	var xs := [player_x]
	for k in stats.ally:
		xs.append(player_x + (int(k / 2.0) + 1) * 60.0 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1))
	return xs


func _fire(delta: float) -> void:
	fire_cd -= delta
	if fire_cd > 0:
		return
	fire_cd = 1.0 / stats.fire_rate
	var n: int = stats.bullets
	for i in n:
		var x := player_x + (i - (n - 1) / 2.0) * 18.0
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - PLAYER_R), damage = stats.damage})
	for x in _shooters().slice(1):
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - 20), damage = stats.damage * 0.5})


func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	for b in bullets:
		b.pos += Vector2(0, -BULLET_SPEED * delta)
	bullets = bullets.filter(func(b): return b.pos.y > -20)
	for e in enemies:
		e.pos += Vector2(0, (BOSS_SPEED if e.kind == "boss" else SCROLL) * delta)
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for b in bullets:
		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0
				b.pos.y = -100  # consumed; filtered next frame
				break

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:
			if e.kind == "boss":
				hp = 0
			elif shield > 0:
				shield -= 1
			else:
				hp -= CONTACT_DAMAGE
		elif e.pos.y < 1400:
			alive.append(e)
	enemies = alive

	var kept: Array = []
	for c in coins:
		if c.distance_to(player) < 45:
			gold += 1
		elif c.y < 1350:
			kept.append(c)
	coins = kept


func _kill(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	match e.kind:
		"enemy":
			coins.append(e.pos)
		"boss":
			for i in 12:
				coins.append(e.pos + Vector2(randf_range(-80, 80), randf_range(-60, 60)))
		"chest":
			bonus_spins += 1
		"mini":
			mini_timer = 0.8


# Mini reel: one cell in the HUD spins from the pool, result is a short buff. Never pauses.
func _mini_reel(delta: float) -> void:
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		return
	mini_timer -= delta
	mini_id = pool.pick_random()
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		var b := Symbols.resolve([mini_id])
		temp_buffs.append({buffs = b, t = TEMP_BUFF_TIME})
		shield += b.shield
		gold += b.gold
		bonus_spins += b.spins


func _end_wave() -> void:
	if level >= LEVELS:
		_game_over("You beat all %d waves!" % LEVELS)
		return
	state = "draft"
	var choices: Array = Symbols.DATA.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "blank")
	choices.shuffle()
	offers = choices.slice(0, 3)


func _pick(i: int) -> void:
	if state != "draft":
		return
	if i >= 0:
		pool.append(offers[i])
	level += 1
	hp = minf(max_hp, hp + HEAL_PER_LEVEL)
	_start_level()


func _game_over(msg: String) -> void:
	state = "over"
	over_label.text = "%s\nGold: %d" % [msg, gold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		"spin":
			_process_spin(delta)
		"wave":
			_process_wave(delta)
	_update_ui()
	queue_redraw()


func _update_ui() -> void:
	hud_label.text = "Wave %d/%d    HP %d/%d    Gold %d" % [level, LEVELS, maxi(0, int(hp)), int(max_hp), gold]
	progress.visible = state == "wave"
	progress.value = distance
	if state == "wave":
		var b := wave_buffs.duplicate()

func _initialize() -> void:
	var run = load("res://scripts/run.gd").new()

	quit()

func _initialize() -> void:
	var Upgrades = load("res://scripts/upgrades.gd")
	var s := {damage = 10.0, fire_rate = 4.0, bullets = 1.0, pierce = 0.0, max_hp = 100.0, hp = 50.0}
	Upgrades.apply(s, Upgrades.POOL[0], 3.9)
	assert(s.damage == 13.0)
	Upgrades.apply(s, Upgrades.POOL[5], 80.0)
	assert(s.hp == 100.0)
	Upgrades.apply(s, Upgrades.POOL[1], 50.0)
	assert(is_equal_approx(s.fire_rate, 6.0))
	print("upgrade checks ok, pick: ", Upgrades.pick_two().map(func(u): return u.id))

	var run = load("res://scripts/run.gd").new()
	root.add_child(run)
	await process_frame
	run.set_process(false)
	var frames := 0
	while not run.over and frames < 60 * 120:
		run._process(1.0 / 60.0)
		frames += 1
	print("ended=", run.over, " t=", frames / 60.0, "s hp=", run.stats.hp, " gold=", run.gold,
		" boss=", run.boss_spawned, " stats=", run.stats, " text=", run.panel_label.text)
	quit()

content.text:
The slot-machine version is built and plays through without script errors in a simulation. I haven't watched it in a window yet.

**A level now runs in three steps:**
1. **Spin screen:** a 3×3 grid of your reel symbols and a SPIN button with 3 spins. **AUTO** plays all remaining spins quickly. **Buy spin** costs 10 gold, then 5 more each time. Each spin shows what it gave, like "+4 dmg, +15% rate, burn 8". When you're out of spins the button changes to **FIGHT!**.
2. **Wave:** the lane shooter, with the gates removed. Enemies drop coins. Gold chests give +1 spin next level. Cyan chests spin a small reel in the top-right corner for a 10-second boost, and the game doesn't pause. The top of the screen shows your active boosts, your shield, and your bonus spins.
3. **Draft:** pick 1 of 3 symbols to add to your pool, or skip. You heal 30 HP between levels.

There are 9 waves, with bosses on waves 3, 6 and 9. Symbols are coloured squares with a letter for now: Bullet, Clock, Twin, Fire (doubled next to a Bullet), Magnet, Shield, Ally, Seven (three in a line is a jackpot) and Skull (a risk symbol).

**Tests:**
- `scripts/symbols_check.gd` checks the scoring rules: Fire next to a Bullet, the jackpot line, Skull, and the draw. It passes.
- A throwaway simulation of a player who never moves, always auto-spins and always takes the first offered symbol cleared waves 1–5. It died to the boss on wave 6 with 41 gold.

**Known gaps:**
- **Early spins all look the same.** The starting pool has 6 symbols, so every spin shows all of them and only their positions change. Luck only starts to matter once the pool has more than 9 symbols. Two possible fixes: a smaller grid early on, or a chance for a cell to land empty.
- **No way to remove symbols** from the pool yet.
- **Balance is untested by a real player.** All the numbers are settings at the top of `scripts/run.gd` (spins, enemy HP scaling, boss HP, wave length).

I deleted `scripts/upgrades.gd`, because the gates it powered are gone.

To play, open a new terminal and run:
```
godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot
```

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")


func _initialize() -> void:
	var _b := "blank"
	# Lone bullet pays base.
	var g := [_b, _b, _b, _b, "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 1.0)

	# Two adjacent bullets: each x2 -> 4. Diagonal does not count.
	g = ["bullet", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 4.0)
	g = ["bullet", _b, _b, _b, "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 2.0)

	# Line of 3: ends have 1 neighbour (x2), middle 2 (x3); line doubles -> (2+3+2)*2 = 14.
	g = ["bullet", "bullet", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 14.0)

	# Fire next to bullet gets +1 mult.
	g = ["fire", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).burn == 2.0)

	# Jackpot: 3 sevens in a column triples the spin.
	g = ["seven", "clock", _b, "seven", _b, _b, "seven", _b, _b]
	var b := Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(Symbols.is_jackpot(g) and b.fire_rate == 15.0)

	# Skull: gold, spin, enemy HP.
	g = ["skull", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	b = Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(b.gold == 4 and b.spins == 1 and is_equal_approx(b.enemy_hp, 0.05))

	# Bag padding: starter pool always mixes in empties, big pools keep the minimum.
	assert(Symbols.bag(Symbols.STARTER).size() == Symbols.BAG_MIN)
	assert(Symbols.bag(range(20)).count("blank") == Symbols.BLANK_MIN)
	assert(Symbols.roll(Symbols.STARTER).size() == 9)
	print("symbols_check ok")
	quit()

extends Node2D
# Level loop: SPIN (slot adds permanent power) -> WAVE (lane shooter) -> DRAFT (add a symbol).
# Incremental: every spin's payout stacks for the whole run; enemies grow exponentially, so
# you need lucky combos, more spins (chests, gold) and a good pool to keep up.

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")

# Tuning
const LEVELS := 9
const BOSS_EVERY := 3
const BASE_SPINS := 3
const SPIN_COST_START := 5
const SPIN_COST_STEP := 3
const HEAL_PER_LEVEL := 25.0
const BASE_DAMAGE := 5.0
const BASE_FIRE_RATE := 4.0
const SCROLL := 200.0
const WAVE_LENGTH := 4000.0
const ROW_GAP := 380.0
const HP_GROWTH := 1.4       # enemy HP multiplier per wave
const ENEMY_HP := 15.0
const ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW := 4.0
const CHASE_SPEED := 70.0    # enemies drift toward you
const BOSS_HP := 1500.0
const BOSS_SPEED := 60.0
const CONTACT_DAMAGE := 15.0
const MINI_MULT := 3.0       # mini reel pays one cell x this
const MAGNET_RANGE := 400.0

# Layout (720x1280 portrait)
const W := 720.0
const LANE_L := 80.0
const LANE_R := 640.0
const PLAYER_Y := 1080.0
const PLAYER_R := 28.0
const BULLET_SPEED := 1100.0
const STEER_SPEED := 800.0
const CELL := 150.0
const GRID_POS := Vector2(135, 300)
const MINI_POS := Vector2(600, 110)
const SPIN_TIME := 0.6
const AUTO_SPIN_TIME := 0.25

var state := "spin"  # spin | wave | draft | over
var level := 1
var max_hp := 100.0
var hp := 100.0
var gold := 0
var pool: Array = []
var power := {}  # permanent run buffs (Symbols.empty_buffs shape)

# Spin phase
var spins_left := 0
var bonus_spins := 0
var spin_cost := SPIN_COST_START
var grid: Array = []
var mults: Array = []
var spin_timer := 0.0
var auto := false
var offers: Array = []

# Wave
var stats := {}
var shield := 0
var mini_id := ""
var mini_timer := 0.0
var distance := 0.0
var player_x := W / 2
var fire_cd := 0.0
var spawn_at := 0.0
var row := 0
var next_id := 0
var boss_spawned := false
var bullets: Array = []  # {pos, damage}
var enemies: Array = []  # {id, kind, pos, hp, r, burn, burn_t}  kind: enemy|boss|chest|mini
var coins: Array = []    # Vector2

var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
var ui: CanvasLayer
var hud_label: Label
var power_label: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var result_label: Label
var spin_btn: Button
var auto_btn: Button
var buy_btn: Button
var draft_title: Label
var draft_btns: Array = []
var skip_btn: Button
var over_label: Label
var restart_btn: Button


func _ready() -> void:
	pool.assign(Symbols.STARTER)
	power = Symbols.empty_buffs()
	ui = CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	hud_label = _label(Vector2(20, 14), Vector2(680, 40), 30)
	progress = ProgressBar.new()
	progress.position = Vector2(20, 60)
	progress.size = Vector2(680, 12)
	progress.show_percentage = false
	progress.max_value = WAVE_LENGTH
	ui.add_child(progress)
	power_label = _label(Vector2(20, 80), Vector2(560, 90), 22)

	result_label = _label(Vector2(40, 780), Vector2(640, 110), 28)
	spin_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 900), Vector2(400, 110), 44, _on_spin)
	auto_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 1030), Vector2(190, 80), 28, _on_auto)
	auto_btn.text = "AUTO"
	buy_btn = _button(Vector2(370, 1030), Vector2(190, 80), 24, _on_buy)

	draft_title = _label(Vector2(0, 280), Vector2(W, 60), 40)
	draft_title.text = "Add a symbol to your reels"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns.append(_button(Vector2(80, 380 + i * 170), Vector2(560, 150), 26, _pick.bind(i)))
	skip_btn = _button(Vector2(260, 900), Vector2(200, 80), 28, _pick.bind(-1))
	skip_btn.text = "Skip"

	over_label = _label(Vector2(0, 480), Vector2(W, 140), 48)
	restart_btn = _button(Vector2(210, 640), Vector2(300, 100), 40, get_tree().reload_current_scene)
	restart_btn.text = "Restart"
	_start_level()


func _label(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.position = pos
	l.size = size
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if size.x >= 600 else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	ui.add_child(l)
	return l


func _button(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int, cb: Callable) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.position = pos
	b.size = size
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	b.pressed.connect(cb)
	ui.add_child(b)
	return b


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spin phase

func _start_level() -> void:
	state = "spin"
	spins_left = BASE_SPINS + bonus_spins
	bonus_spins = 0
	grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
	mults = []
	auto = false
	_calc_stats()
	result_label.text = "Wave %d%s: enemies x%s HP" % [level, "  BOSS" if _boss_level() else "", Symbols.num(_hp_scale())]


func _boss_level() -> bool:
	return level % BOSS_EVERY == 0


func _hp_scale() -> float:
	return pow(HP_GROWTH, level - 1) * (1.0 + power.enemy_hp)


func _on_spin() -> void:
	if state != "spin" or spin_timer > 0:
		return
	if spins_left > 0:
		spins_left -= 1
		spin_timer = AUTO_SPIN_TIME if auto else SPIN_TIME
		mults = []
	else:
		_start_wave()


func _on_auto() -> void:
	auto = true
	_on_spin()


func _on_buy() -> void:
	if state == "spin" and gold >= spin_cost:
		gold -= spin_cost
		spins_left += 1
		spin_cost += SPIN_COST_STEP


func _process_spin(delta: float) -> void:
	if spin_timer > 0:
		spin_timer -= delta
		grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
		if spin_timer <= 0:
			mults = Symbols.cell_mults(grid)
			var b := Symbols.resolve(grid)
			Symbols.add(power, b)
			gold += b.gold
			bonus_spins += b.spins
			_calc_stats()
			var best: float = mults.max()
			var tag := "JACKPOT x3!  " if Symbols.is_jackpot(grid) else ("COMBO x%d!  " % best if best > 1 else "")
			result_label.text = tag + Symbols.summary(b)
	elif auto:
		_on_spin()


func _power_text() -> String:
	return "DMG %s   RATE %s/s   BULLETS %s\nBURN %s   SHIELD %s   ALLY %s   MAGNET %s" % [
		Symbols.num(stats.damage), Symbols.num(stats.fire_rate), Symbols.num(1 + power.bullets),
		Symbols.num(power.burn), Symbols.num(power.shield), Symbols.num(power.ally), Symbols.num(power.magnet)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave

func _start_wave() -> void:
	state = "wave"
	distance = 0.0
	spawn_at = 300.0
	row = 0
	boss_spawned = false
	bullets.clear()
	enemies.clear()
	coins.clear()
	mini_id = ""
	shield = int(power.shield)
	_calc_stats()


func _calc_stats() -> void:
	stats = {
		damage = BASE_DAMAGE + power.damage,
		fire_rate = BASE_FIRE_RATE * (1.0 + power.fire_rate / 100.0),
		bullets = 1 + int(power.bullets),
		burn = power.burn,
		magnet = power.magnet,
		ally = int(power.ally),
	}


func _process_wave(delta: float) -> void:
	distance += SCROLL * delta
	_steer(delta)
	_spawn()
	_fire(delta)
	_move(delta)
	_collide()
	_mini_reel(delta)
	if hp <= 0:
		_game_over("You died on wave %d" % level)
	elif distance >= WAVE_LENGTH and enemies.is_empty() and (boss_spawned or not _boss_level()):
		_end_wave()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state == "wave" and event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
		player_x += event.relative.x


func _steer(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 0.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
		dir -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
		dir += 1.0
	player_x = clampf(player_x + dir * STEER_SPEED * delta, LANE_L + PLAYER_R, LANE_R - PLAYER_R)


func _spawn() -> void:
	if distance < spawn_at:
		return
	var scale := _hp_scale()
	if distance >= WAVE_LENGTH:
		if _boss_level() and not boss_spawned:
			boss_spawned = true
			_add("boss", Vector2(W / 2, -120), BOSS_HP * scale, 90.0)
		return
	if row % 3 == 2:
		var kind := "mini" if randf() < 0.5 else "chest"
		_add(kind, Vector2(randf_range(LANE_L + 60, LANE_R - 60), -40), 3.0 * ENEMY_HP * scale, 34.0)
	else:
		var n := randi_range(3, 5)
		for i in n:
			var x := lerpf(LANE_L + 40, LANE_R - 40, (i + 0.5) / n)
			_add("enemy", Vector2(x, -40), (ENEMY_HP + row * ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW) * scale, 26.0)
	row += 1
	spawn_at += ROW_GAP


func _add(kind: String, pos: Vector2, hp_: float, r: float) -> void:
	enemies.append({id = next_id, kind = kind, pos = pos, hp = hp_, r = r, burn = 0.0, burn_t = 0.0})
	next_id += 1


func _shooters() -> Array:
	var xs := [player_x]
	for k in stats.ally:
		xs.append(player_x + (int(k / 2.0) + 1) * 60.0 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1))
	return xs


func _fire(delta: float) -> void:
	fire_cd -= delta
	if fire_cd > 0:
		return
	fire_cd = 1.0 / stats.fire_rate
	var n: int = stats.bullets
	for i in n:
		var x := player_x + (i - (n - 1) / 2.0) * 18.0
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - PLAYER_R), damage = stats.damage})
	for x in _shooters().slice(1):
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - 20), damage = stats.damage * 0.5})


func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	for b in bullets:
		b.pos += Vector2(0, -BULLET_SPEED * delta)
	bullets = bullets.filter(func(b): return b.pos.y > -20)
	for e in enemies:
		var p: Vector2 = e.pos
		if e.kind == "boss":
			p.y += BOSS_SPEED * delta
		else:
			p.y += SCROLL * delta
			if e.kind == "enemy" and p.y > 0:
				p.x = move_toward(p.x, player_x, CHASE_SPEED * delta)
		e.pos = p
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for b in bullets:
		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0
				b.pos.y = -100  # consumed; filtered next frame
				break

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:
			if e.kind == "boss":
				hp = 0
			elif shield > 0:
				shield -= 1
			else:
				hp -= CONTACT_DAMAGE
		elif e.pos.y < 1400:
			alive.append(e)
	enemies = alive

	var kept: Array = []
	for c in coins:
		if c.distance_to(player) < 45:
			gold += 1
		elif c.y < 1350:
			kept.append(c)
	coins = kept


func _kill(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	match e.kind:
		"enemy":
			coins.append(e.pos)
		"boss":
			for i in 15:
				coins.append(e.pos + Vector2(randf_range(-80, 80), randf_range(-60, 60)))
		"chest":
			bonus_spins += 1
		"mini":
			mini_timer = 0.8


# Mini reel: one HUD cell spins from the bag (empties included), pays x MINI_MULT. Never pauses.
func _mini_reel(delta: float) -> void:
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		return
	mini_timer -= delta
	mini_id = Symbols.bag(pool).pick_random()
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		var b := Symbols.empty_buffs()
		Symbols.apply_cell(b, mini_id, MINI_MULT)
		Symbols.add(power, b)
		gold += b.gold
		bonus_spins += b.spins
		shield += int(b.shield)
		_calc_stats()


func _end_wave() -> void:
	if level >= LEVELS:
		_game_over("You beat all %d waves!" % LEVELS)
		return
	state = "draft"
	var choices: Array = Symbols.DATA.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "blank")
	choices.shuffle()
	offers = choices.slice(0, 3)


func _pick(i: int) -> void:
	if state != "draft":
		return
	if i >= 0:
		pool.append(offers[i])
	level += 1
	hp = minf(max_hp, hp + HEAL_PER_LEVEL)
	_start_level()


func _game_over(msg: String) -> void:
	state = "over"
	over_label.text = "%s\nGold: %d" % [msg, gold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		"spin":
			_process_spin(delta)
		"wave":
			_process_wave(delta)
	_update_ui()
	queue_redraw()


func _update_ui() -> void:
	hud_label.text = "Wave %d/%d    HP %d/%d    Gold %d" % [level, LEVELS, maxi(0, int(hp)), int(max_hp), gold]
	progress.visible = state == "wave"
	progress.value = distance
	power_label.visible = state in ["spin", "wave"]
	power_label.text = _power_text() + ("\nShields left %d   Next wave spins +%d" % [shield, bonus_spins] if state == "wave" else "")

	for c in [result_label, spin_btn, auto_btn, buy_btn]:
		c.visible = state == "spin"
	spin_btn.text = "SPIN (%d)" % spins_left if spins_left > 0 or spin_timer > 0 else "FIGHT!"
	buy_btn.text = "Buy spin\n%d gold" % spin_cost
	buy_btn.disabled = gold < spin_cost

	draft_title.visible = state == "draft"
	skip_btn.visible = state == "draft"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns[i].visible = state == "draft"
		if state == "draft":
			var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[offers[i]]
			draft_btns[i].text = "%s\n%s" % [d.name, d.desc]
	over_label.visible = state == "over"
	restart_btn.visible = state == "over"


func _draw_cell(rect: Rect2, id: String, mult := 1.0) -> void:
	var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[id]
	draw_rect(rect.grow(-6), d.color)
	draw_string(font, Vector2(rect.position.x, rect.get_center().y + rect.size.y * 0.15), d.letter,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.45), Color.BLACK)
	if mult > 1:
		draw_rect(rect.grow(-4), Color("ffe14d"), false, 6.0)
		draw_string(font, rect.position + Vector2(12, 40), "x%d" % mult,
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 32, Color.WHITE)


func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color("2b3a2f"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(LANE_L, 0, LANE_R - LANE_L, 1280), Color("5a5f66"))
	var off := fmod(distance, 160.0)
	for i in 10:
		draw_rect(Rect2(W / 2 - 4, off + i * 160.0 - 160.0, 8, 70), Color("8a8f96"))

	if state == "wave" or state == "over":
		for c in coins:
			draw_circle(c, 9.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		for e in enemies:
			var col: Color = {enemy = Color("d94a4a"), boss = Color("8e2b8e"), chest = Color("e0b040"), mini = Color("4ad0e0")}[e.kind]
			if e.kind in ["chest", "mini"]:
				draw_rect(Rect2(e.pos - Vector2(e.r, e.r), Vector2(e.r, e.r) * 2), col)
			else:
				draw_circle(e.pos, e.r, col.lerp(Color.ORANGE, 0.4) if e.burn_t > 0 else col)
			draw_string(font, e.pos + Vector2(-e.r, 10), str(ceili(e.hp)),
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, e.r * 2, 48 if e.kind == "boss" else 24)
		for b in bullets:
			draw_circle(b.pos, 6.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		var shooters := _shooters() if state == "wave" else [player_x]
		for x in shooters.slice(1):
			draw_circle(Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y + 10), 18.0, Color("7fa8ff"))
		draw_circle(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R, Color("3d7bff"))
		if shield > 0:
			draw_arc(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R + 8, 0, TAU, 32, Color("4ae08a"), 4.0)
		if mini_id != "":
			_draw_cell(Rect2(MINI_POS, Vector2(90, 90)), mini_id)

	if state in ["spin", "draft", "over"]:
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	if state == "spin":
		draw_rect(Rect2(GRID_POS - Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(CELL * 3 + 24, CELL * 3 + 24)), Color("1a1a22"))
		for i in 9:
			_draw_cell(Rect2(GRID_POS + Vector2(i % 3, int(i / 3.0)) * CELL, Vector2(CELL, CELL)), grid[i],
				mults[i] if mults.size() == 9 else 1.0)
		draw_string(font, Vector2(0, GRID_POS.y + CELL * 3 + 50), "Reel bag: %d symbols + %d empty" % [pool.size(), Symbols.bag(pool).size() - pool.size()],
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, W, 24)
