extends Node2D
# Level loop: SPIN (slot adds permanent power) -> WAVE (lane shooter) -> DRAFT (add a symbol).
# Incremental: every spin's payout stacks for the whole run; enemies grow exponentially, so
# you need lucky combos, more spins (chests, gold) and a good pool to keep up.

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")

# Tuning
const LEVELS := 9
const BOSS_EVERY := 3
const BASE_SPINS := 3
const SPIN_COST_START := 5
const SPIN_COST_STEP := 3
const HEAL_PER_LEVEL := 25.0
const BASE_DAMAGE := 5.0
const BASE_FIRE_RATE := 4.0
const SCROLL := 200.0
const WAVE_LENGTH := 4000.0
const ROW_GAP := 380.0
const HP_GROWTH := 1.4       # enemy HP multiplier per wave
const ENEMY_HP := 15.0
const ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW := 4.0
const CHASE_SPEED := 70.0    # enemies drift toward you
const BOSS_HP := 1500.0
const BOSS_SPEED := 60.0
const CONTACT_DAMAGE := 15.0
const MINI_MULT := 3.0       # mini reel pays one cell x this
const MAGNET_RANGE := 400.0

# Layout (720x1280 portrait)
const W := 720.0
const LANE_L := 80.0
const LANE_R := 640.0
const PLAYER_Y := 1080.0
const PLAYER_R := 28.0
const BULLET_SPEED := 1100.0
const STEER_SPEED := 800.0
const CELL := 150.0
const GRID_POS := Vector2(135, 300)
const MINI_POS := Vector2(600, 110)
const SPIN_TIME := 0.6
const AUTO_SPIN_TIME := 0.25

var state := "spin"  # spin | wave | draft | over
var level := 1
var max_hp := 100.0
var hp := 100.0
var gold := 0
var pool: Array = []
var power := {}  # permanent run buffs (Symbols.empty_buffs shape)

# Spin phase
var spins_left := 0
var bonus_spins := 0
var spin_cost := SPIN_COST_START
var grid: Array = []
var mults: Array = []
var spin_timer := 0.0
var auto := false
var offers: Array = []

# Wave
var stats := {}
var shield := 0
var mini_id := ""
var mini_timer := 0.0
var distance := 0.0
var player_x := W / 2
var fire_cd := 0.0
var spawn_at := 0.0
var row := 0
var next_id := 0
var boss_spawned := false
var bullets: Array = []  # {pos, damage}
var enemies: Array = []  # {id, kind, pos, hp, r, burn, burn_t}  kind: enemy|boss|chest|mini
var coins: Array = []    # Vector2

var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
var ui: CanvasLayer
var hud_label: Label
var power_label: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var result_label: Label
var spin_btn: Button
var auto_btn: Button
var buy_btn: Button
var draft_title: Label
var draft_btns: Array = []
var skip_btn: Button
var over_label: Label
var restart_btn: Button


func _ready() -> void:
	pool.assign(Symbols.STARTER)
	power = Symbols.empty_buffs()
	ui = CanvasLayer.new()
	add_child(ui)
	hud_label = _label(Vector2(20, 14), Vector2(680, 40), 30)
	progress = ProgressBar.new()
	progress.position = Vector2(20, 60)
	progress.size = Vector2(680, 12)
	progress.show_percentage = false
	progress.max_value = WAVE_LENGTH
	ui.add_child(progress)
	power_label = _label(Vector2(20, 80), Vector2(560, 90), 22)

	result_label = _label(Vector2(40, 780), Vector2(640, 110), 28)
	spin_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 900), Vector2(400, 110), 44, _on_spin)
	auto_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 1030), Vector2(190, 80), 28, _on_auto)
	auto_btn.text = "AUTO"
	buy_btn = _button(Vector2(370, 1030), Vector2(190, 80), 24, _on_buy)

	draft_title = _label(Vector2(0, 280), Vector2(W, 60), 40)
	draft_title.text = "Add a symbol to your reels"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns.append(_button(Vector2(80, 380 + i * 170), Vector2(560, 150), 26, _pick.bind(i)))
	skip_btn = _button(Vector2(260, 900), Vector2(200, 80), 28, _pick.bind(-1))
	skip_btn.text = "Skip"

	over_label = _label(Vector2(0, 480), Vector2(W, 140), 48)
	restart_btn = _button(Vector2(210, 640), Vector2(300, 100), 40, get_tree().reload_current_scene)
	restart_btn.text = "Restart"
	_start_level()


func _label(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var l := Label.new()
	l.position = pos
	l.size = size
	l.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if size.x >= 600 else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	l.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	l.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	ui.add_child(l)
	return l


func _button(pos: Vector2, size: Vector2, font_size: int, cb: Callable) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.position = pos
	b.size = size
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	b.pressed.connect(cb)
	ui.add_child(b)
	return b


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spin phase

func _start_level() -> void:
	state = "spin"
	spins_left = BASE_SPINS + bonus_spins
	bonus_spins = 0
	grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
	mults = []
	auto = false
	_calc_stats()
	result_label.text = "Wave %d%s: enemies x%s HP" % [level, "  BOSS" if _boss_level() else "", Symbols.num(_hp_scale())]


func _boss_level() -> bool:
	return level % BOSS_EVERY == 0


func _hp_scale() -> float:
	return pow(HP_GROWTH, level - 1) * (1.0 + power.enemy_hp)


func _on_spin() -> void:
	if state != "spin" or spin_timer > 0:
		return
	if spins_left > 0:
		spins_left -= 1
		spin_timer = AUTO_SPIN_TIME if auto else SPIN_TIME
		mults = []
	else:
		_start_wave()


func _on_auto() -> void:
	auto = true
	_on_spin()


func _on_buy() -> void:
	if state == "spin" and gold >= spin_cost:
		gold -= spin_cost
		spins_left += 1
		spin_cost += SPIN_COST_STEP


func _process_spin(delta: float) -> void:
	if spin_timer > 0:
		spin_timer -= delta
		grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
		if spin_timer <= 0:
			mults = Symbols.cell_mults(grid)
			var b := Symbols.resolve(grid)
			Symbols.add(power, b)
			gold += b.gold
			bonus_spins += b.spins
			_calc_stats()
			var best: float = mults.max()
			var tag := "JACKPOT x3!  " if Symbols.is_jackpot(grid) else ("COMBO x%d!  " % best if best > 1 else "")
			result_label.text = tag + Symbols.summary(b)
	elif auto:
		_on_spin()


func _power_text() -> String:
	return "DMG %s   RATE %s/s   BULLETS %s\nBURN %s   SHIELD %s   ALLY %s   MAGNET %s" % [
		Symbols.num(stats.damage), Symbols.num(stats.fire_rate), Symbols.num(1 + power.bullets),
		Symbols.num(power.burn), Symbols.num(power.shield), Symbols.num(power.ally), Symbols.num(power.magnet)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave

func _start_wave() -> void:
	state = "wave"
	distance = 0.0
	spawn_at = 300.0
	row = 0
	boss_spawned = false
	bullets.clear()
	enemies.clear()
	coins.clear()
	mini_id = ""
	shield = int(power.shield)
	_calc_stats()


func _calc_stats() -> void:
	stats = {
		damage = BASE_DAMAGE + power.damage,
		fire_rate = BASE_FIRE_RATE * (1.0 + power.fire_rate / 100.0),
		bullets = 1 + int(power.bullets),
		burn = power.burn,
		magnet = power.magnet,
		ally = int(power.ally),
	}


func _process_wave(delta: float) -> void:
	distance += SCROLL * delta
	_steer(delta)
	_spawn()
	_fire(delta)
	_move(delta)
	_collide()
	_mini_reel(delta)
	if hp <= 0:
		_game_over("You died on wave %d" % level)
	elif distance >= WAVE_LENGTH and enemies.is_empty() and (boss_spawned or not _boss_level()):
		_end_wave()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state == "wave" and event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
		player_x += event.relative.x


func _steer(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 0.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
		dir -= 1.0
	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
		dir += 1.0
	player_x = clampf(player_x + dir * STEER_SPEED * delta, LANE_L + PLAYER_R, LANE_R - PLAYER_R)


func _spawn() -> void:
	if distance < spawn_at:
		return
	var scale := _hp_scale()
	if distance >= WAVE_LENGTH:
		if _boss_level() and not boss_spawned:
			boss_spawned = true
			_add("boss", Vector2(W / 2, -120), BOSS_HP * scale, 90.0)
		return
	if row % 3 == 2:
		var kind := "mini" if randf() < 0.5 else "chest"
		_add(kind, Vector2(randf_range(LANE_L + 60, LANE_R - 60), -40), 3.0 * ENEMY_HP * scale, 34.0)
	else:
		var n := randi_range(3, 5)
		for i in n:
			var x := lerpf(LANE_L + 40, LANE_R - 40, (i + 0.5) / n)
			_add("enemy", Vector2(x, -40), (ENEMY_HP + row * ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW) * scale, 26.0)
	row += 1
	spawn_at += ROW_GAP


func _add(kind: String, pos: Vector2, hp_: float, r: float) -> void:
	enemies.append({id = next_id, kind = kind, pos = pos, hp = hp_, r = r, burn = 0.0, burn_t = 0.0})
	next_id += 1


func _shooters() -> Array:
	var xs := [player_x]
	for k in stats.ally:
		xs.append(player_x + (int(k / 2.0) + 1) * 60.0 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1))
	return xs


func _fire(delta: float) -> void:
	fire_cd -= delta
	if fire_cd > 0:
		return
	fire_cd = 1.0 / stats.fire_rate
	var n: int = stats.bullets
	for i in n:
		var x := player_x + (i - (n - 1) / 2.0) * 18.0
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - PLAYER_R), damage = stats.damage})
	for x in _shooters().slice(1):
		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - 20), damage = stats.damage * 0.5})


func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	for b in bullets:
		b.pos += Vector2(0, -BULLET_SPEED * delta)
	bullets = bullets.filter(func(b): return b.pos.y > -20)
	for e in enemies:
		var p: Vector2 = e.pos
		if e.kind == "boss":
			p.y += BOSS_SPEED * delta
		else:
			p.y += SCROLL * delta
			if e.kind == "enemy" and p.y > 0:
				p.x = move_toward(p.x, player_x, CHASE_SPEED * delta)
		e.pos = p
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for b in bullets:
		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0
				b.pos.y = -100  # consumed; filtered next frame
				break

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:
			if e.kind == "boss":
				hp = 0
			elif shield > 0:
				shield -= 1
			else:
				hp -= CONTACT_DAMAGE
		elif e.pos.y < 1400:
			alive.append(e)
	enemies = alive

	var kept: Array = []
	for c in coins:
		if c.distance_to(player) < 45:
			gold += 1
		elif c.y < 1350:
			kept.append(c)
	coins = kept


func _kill(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	match e.kind:
		"enemy":
			coins.append(e.pos)
		"boss":
			for i in 15:
				coins.append(e.pos + Vector2(randf_range(-80, 80), randf_range(-60, 60)))
		"chest":
			bonus_spins += 1
		"mini":
			mini_timer = 0.8


# Mini reel: one HUD cell spins from the bag (empties included), pays x MINI_MULT. Never pauses.
func _mini_reel(delta: float) -> void:
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		return
	mini_timer -= delta
	mini_id = Symbols.bag(pool).pick_random()
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		var b := Symbols.empty_buffs()
		Symbols.apply_cell(b, mini_id, MINI_MULT)
		Symbols.add(power, b)
		gold += b.gold
		bonus_spins += b.spins
		shield += int(b.shield)
		_calc_stats()


func _end_wave() -> void:
	if level >= LEVELS:
		_game_over("You beat all %d waves!" % LEVELS)
		return
	state = "draft"
	var choices: Array = Symbols.DATA.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "blank")
	choices.shuffle()
	offers = choices.slice(0, 3)


func _pick(i: int) -> void:
	if state != "draft":
		return
	if i >= 0:
		pool.append(offers[i])
	level += 1
	hp = minf(max_hp, hp + HEAL_PER_LEVEL)
	_start_level()


func _game_over(msg: String) -> void:
	state = "over"
	over_label.text = "%s\nGold: %d" % [msg, gold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		"spin":
			_process_spin(delta)
		"wave":
			_process_wave(delta)
	_update_ui()
	queue_redraw()


func _update_ui() -> void:
	hud_label.text = "Wave %d/%d    HP %d/%d    Gold %d" % [level, LEVELS, maxi(0, int(hp)), int(max_hp), gold]
	progress.visible = state == "wave"
	progress.value = distance
	power_label.visible = state in ["spin", "wave"]
	power_label.text = _power_text() + ("\nShields left %d   Next wave spins +%d" % [shield, bonus_spins] if state == "wave" else "")

	for c in [result_label, spin_btn, auto_btn, buy_btn]:
		c.visible = state == "spin"
	spin_btn.text = "SPIN (%d)" % spins_left if spins_left > 0 or spin_timer > 0 else "FIGHT!"
	buy_btn.text = "Buy spin\n%d gold" % spin_cost
	buy_btn.disabled = gold < spin_cost

	draft_title.visible = state == "draft"
	skip_btn.visible = state == "draft"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns[i].visible = state == "draft"
		if state == "draft":
			var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[offers[i]]
			draft_btns[i].text = "%s\n%s" % [d.name, d.desc]
	over_label.visible = state == "over"
	restart_btn.visible = state == "over"


func _draw_cell(rect: Rect2, id: String, mult := 1.0) -> void:
	var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[id]
	draw_rect(rect.grow(-6), d.color)
	draw_string(font, Vector2(rect.position.x, rect.get_center().y + rect.size.y * 0.15), d.letter,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.45), Color.BLACK)
	if mult > 1:
		draw_rect(rect.grow(-4), Color("ffe14d"), false, 6.0)
		draw_string(font, rect.position + Vector2(12, 40), "x%d" % mult,
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 32, Color.WHITE)


func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color("2b3a2f"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(LANE_L, 0, LANE_R - LANE_L, 1280), Color("5a5f66"))
	var off := fmod(distance, 160.0)
	for i in 10:
		draw_rect(Rect2(W / 2 - 4, off + i * 160.0 - 160.0, 8, 70), Color("8a8f96"))

	if state == "wave" or state == "over":
		for c in coins:
			draw_circle(c, 9.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		for e in enemies:
			var col: Color = {enemy = Color("d94a4a"), boss = Color("8e2b8e"), chest = Color("e0b040"), mini = Color("4ad0e0")}[e.kind]
			if e.kind in ["chest", "mini"]:
				draw_rect(Rect2(e.pos - Vector2(e.r, e.r), Vector2(e.r, e.r) * 2), col)
			else:
				draw_circle(e.pos, e.r, col.lerp(Color.ORANGE, 0.4) if e.burn_t > 0 else col)
			draw_string(font, e.pos + Vector2(-e.r, 10), str(ceili(e.hp)),
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, e.r * 2, 48 if e.kind == "boss" else 24)
		for b in bullets:
			draw_circle(b.pos, 6.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		var shooters := _shooters() if state == "wave" else [player_x]
		for x in shooters.slice(1):
			draw_circle(Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y + 10), 18.0, Color("7fa8ff"))
		draw_circle(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R, Color("3d7bff"))
		if shield > 0:
			draw_arc(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R + 8, 0, TAU, 32, Color("4ae08a"), 4.0)
		if mini_id != "":
			_draw_cell(Rect2(MINI_POS, Vector2(90, 90)), mini_id)

	if state in ["spin", "draft", "over"]:
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	if state == "spin":
		draw_rect(Rect2(GRID_POS - Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(CELL * 3 + 24, CELL * 3 + 24)), Color("1a1a22"))
		for i in 9:
			_draw_cell(Rect2(GRID_POS + Vector2(i % 3, int(i / 3.0)) * CELL, Vector2(CELL, CELL)), grid[i],
				mults[i] if mults.size() == 9 else 1.0)
		draw_string(font, Vector2(0, GRID_POS.y + CELL * 3 + 50), "Reel bag: %d symbols + %d empty" % [pool.size(), Symbols.bag(pool).size() - pool.size()],
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, W, 24)

# Incremental: every spin's payout stacks for the whole run; enemies grow exponentially, so
# you need lucky combos, more spins (chests, gold) and a good pool to keep up.

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")

# Tuning
const LEVELS := 9
const BOSS_EVERY := 3
const BASE_SPINS := 3
const SPIN_COST_START := 5
const SPIN_COST_STEP := 3
const HEAL_PER_LEVEL := 25.0
const BASE_DAMAGE := 5.0
const BASE_FIRE_RATE := 4.0
const SCROLL := 200.0
const WAVE_LENGTH := 4000.0
const ROW_GAP := 380.0
const HP_GROWTH := 1.4       # enemy HP multiplier per wave
const ENEMY_HP := 15.0
const ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW := 4.0
const CHASE_SPEED := 70.0    # enemies drift toward you
const BOSS_HP := 1500.0
const BOSS_SPEED := 60.0
const CONTACT_DAMAGE := 15.0
const MINI_MULT := 3.0       # mini reel pays one cell x this
const MAGNET_RANGE := 400.0

# Layout (720x1280 portrait)
const W := 720.0
const LANE_L := 80.0
const LANE_R := 640.0
const PLAYER_Y := 1080.0
const PLAYER_R := 28.0
const BULLET_SPEED := 1100.0
const STEER_SPEED := 800.0
const CELL := 150.0
const GRID_POS := Vector2(135, 300)
const MINI_POS := Vector2(600, 110)
const SPIN_TIME := 0.6
const AUTO_SPIN_TIME := 0.25

var state := "spin"  # spin | wave | draft | over
var level := 1
var max_hp := 100.0
var hp := 100.0
var gold := 0
var pool: Array = []
var power := {}  # permanent run buffs (Symbols.empty_buffs shape)

var bonus_spins := 0
var spin_cost := SPIN_COST_START
var grid: Array = []
var mults: Array = []
var spin_timer := 0.0
var auto := false
var offers: Array = []

# Wave
var stats := {}
var shield := 0
var mini_id := ""
var mini_timer := 0.0
var distance := 0.0
var player_x := W / 2
var fire_cd := 0.0
var spawn_at := 0.0
var row := 0
var next_id := 0
var boss_spawned := false

var ui: CanvasLayer

var power_label: Label
var progress: ProgressBar
var result_label: Label
var spin_btn: Button

func _ready() -> void:

	progress.show_percentage = false

	result_label = _label(Vector2(40, 780), Vector2(640, 110), 28)

	auto_btn = _button(Vector2(160, 1030), Vector2(190, 80), 28, _on_auto)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- spin phase

func _start_level() -> void:

	grid = Symbols.roll(pool)
	mults = []

	return "DMG %s   RATE %s/s   BULLETS %s\nBURN %s   SHIELD %s   ALLY %s   MAGNET %s" % [
		Symbols.num(stats.damage), Symbols.num(stats.fire_rate), Symbols.num(1 + power.bullets),
		Symbols.num(power.burn), Symbols.num(power.shield), Symbols.num(power.ally), Symbols.num(power.magnet)]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wave

	distance = 0.0
	spawn_at = 300.0
	row = 0

	distance += SCROLL * delta

	_spawn()
	_fire(delta)
	_move(delta)

		_game_over("You died on wave %d" % level)
	elif distance >= WAVE_LENGTH and enemies.is_empty() and (boss_spawned or not _boss_level()):
		_end_wave()


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if state == "wave" and event is InputEventMouseMotion and event.button_mask & MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT:
		player_x += event.relative.x


func _steer(delta: float) -> void:

	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):

		_add(kind, Vector2(randf_range(LANE_L + 60, LANE_R - 60), -40), 3.0 * ENEMY_HP * scale, 34.0)
	else:
		var n := randi_range(3, 5)
		for i in n:
			var x := lerpf(LANE_L + 40, LANE_R - 40, (i + 0.5) / n)
			_add("enemy", Vector2(x, -40), (ENEMY_HP + row * ENEMY_HP_PER_ROW) * scale, 26.0)

	spawn_at += ROW_GAP


func _add(kind: String, pos: Vector2, hp_: float, r: float) -> void:
	enemies.append({id = next_id, kind = kind, pos = pos, hp = hp_, r = r, burn = 0.0, burn_t = 0.0})
	next_id += 1


func _shooters() -> Array:
	var xs := [player_x]
	for k in stats.ally:
		xs.append(player_x + (int(k / 2.0) + 1) * 60.0 * (1 if k % 2 == 0 else -1))
	return xs


func _fire(delta: float) -> void:
	fire_cd -= delta
	if fire_cd > 0:
		return

	var n: int = stats.bullets
	for i in n:

		bullets.append({pos = Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y - PLAYER_R), damage = stats.damage})
	for x in _shooters().slice(1):

func _move(delta: float) -> void:
	for b in bullets:
		b.pos += Vector2(0, -BULLET_SPEED * delta)
	bullets = bullets.filter(func(b): return b.pos.y > -20)
	for e in enemies:

			p.y += BOSS_SPEED * delta
		else:
			p.y += SCROLL * delta
			if e.kind == "enemy" and p.y > 0:
				p.x = move_toward(p.x, player_x, CHASE_SPEED * delta)
		e.pos = p
		if e.burn_t > 0:
			e.burn_t -= delta
			e.hp -= e.burn * delta
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for i in coins.size():
		var c: Vector2 = coins[i]
		if stats.magnet > 0 and c.distance_to(player) < MAGNET_RANGE * stats.magnet:
			coins[i] = c.move_toward(player, 700.0 * delta)
		else:
			coins[i] = c + Vector2(0, SCROLL * delta)


func _collide() -> void:
	var player := Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y)
	for b in bullets:
		for e in enemies:
			if e.hp > 0 and b.pos.distance_to(e.pos) < e.r:
				e.hp -= b.damage
				if stats.burn > 0:
					e.burn = stats.burn
					e.burn_t = 2.0
				b.pos.y = -100  # consumed; filtered next frame
				break

	var alive: Array = []
	for e in enemies:
		if e.hp <= 0:
			_kill(e)
		elif e.kind in ["enemy", "boss"] and e.pos.distance_to(player) < e.r + PLAYER_R:
			if e.kind == "boss":
				hp = 0
			elif shield > 0:
				shield -= 1
			else:
				hp -= CONTACT_DAMAGE
		elif e.pos.y < 1400:
			alive.append(e)
	enemies = alive

	var kept: Array = []
	for c in coins:
		if c.distance_to(player) < 45:
			gold += 1
		elif c.y < 1350:
			kept.append(c)
	coins = kept


func _kill(e: Dictionary) -> void:
	match e.kind:
		"enemy":
			coins.append(e.pos)
		"boss":
			for i in 15:
				coins.append(e.pos + Vector2(randf_range(-80, 80), randf_range(-60, 60)))
		"chest":
			bonus_spins += 1
		"mini":
			mini_timer = 0.8


# Mini reel: one HUD cell spins from the bag (empties included), pays x MINI_MULT. Never pauses.
func _mini_reel(delta: float) -> void:
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		return
	mini_timer -= delta
	mini_id = Symbols.bag(pool).pick_random()
	if mini_timer <= 0:
		var b := Symbols.empty_buffs()
		Symbols.apply_cell(b, mini_id, MINI_MULT)
		Symbols.add(power, b)
		gold += b.gold
		bonus_spins += b.spins
		shield += int(b.shield)
		_calc_stats()


func _end_wave() -> void:
	if level >= LEVELS:
		_game_over("You beat all %d waves!" % LEVELS)
		return
	state = "draft"
	var choices: Array = Symbols.DATA.keys().filter(func(k): return k != "blank")
	choices.shuffle()
	offers = choices.slice(0, 3)


func _pick(i: int) -> void:
	if state != "draft":
		return
	if i >= 0:
		pool.append(offers[i])
	level += 1
	hp = minf(max_hp, hp + HEAL_PER_LEVEL)
	_start_level()


func _game_over(msg: String) -> void:
	state = "over"
	over_label.text = "%s\nGold: %d" % [msg, gold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		"spin":
			_process_spin(delta)
		"wave":
			_process_wave(delta)
	_update_ui()
	queue_redraw()


func _update_ui() -> void:
	hud_label.text = "Wave %d/%d    HP %d/%d    Gold %d" % [level, LEVELS, maxi(0, int(hp)), int(max_hp), gold]
	progress.visible = state == "wave"
	progress.value = distance
	power_label.visible = state in ["spin", "wave"]
	power_label.text = _power_text() + ("\nShields left %d   Next wave spins +%d" % [shield, bonus_spins] if state == "wave" else "")

	for c in [result_label, spin_btn, auto_btn, buy_btn]:
		c.visible = state == "spin"
	spin_btn.text = "SPIN (%d)" % spins_left if spins_left > 0 or spin_timer > 0 else "FIGHT!"
	buy_btn.text = "Buy spin\n%d gold" % spin_cost
	buy_btn.disabled = gold < spin_cost

	draft_title.visible = state == "draft"
	skip_btn.visible = state == "draft"
	for i in 3:
		draft_btns[i].visible = state == "draft"
		if state == "draft":
			var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[offers[i]]
			draft_btns[i].text = "%s\n%s" % [d.name, d.desc]
	over_label.visible = state == "over"
	restart_btn.visible = state == "over"


func _draw_cell(rect: Rect2, id: String, mult := 1.0) -> void:
	var d: Dictionary = Symbols.DATA[id]
	draw_rect(rect.grow(-6), d.color)
	draw_string(font, Vector2(rect.position.x, rect.get_center().y + rect.size.y * 0.15), d.letter,
		HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.45), Color.BLACK)
	if mult > 1:
		draw_rect(rect.grow(-4), Color("ffe14d"), false, 6.0)
		draw_string(font, rect.position + Vector2(12, 40), "x%d" % mult,
			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 32, Color.WHITE)


func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color("2b3a2f"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(LANE_L, 0, LANE_R - LANE_L, 1280), Color("5a5f66"))
	var off := fmod(distance, 160.0)
	for i in 10:
		draw_rect(Rect2(W / 2 - 4, off + i * 160.0 - 160.0, 8, 70), Color("8a8f96"))

	if state == "wave" or state == "over":
		for c in coins:
			draw_circle(c, 9.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		for e in enemies:
			var col: Color = {enemy = Color("d94a4a"), boss = Color("8e2b8e"), chest = Color("e0b040"), mini = Color("4ad0e0")}[e.kind]
			if e.kind in ["chest", "mini"]:
				draw_rect(Rect2(e.pos - Vector2(e.r, e.r), Vector2(e.r, e.r) * 2), col)
			else:
				draw_circle(e.pos, e.r, col.lerp(Color.ORANGE, 0.4) if e.burn_t > 0 else col)
			draw_string(font, e.pos + Vector2(-e.r, 10), str(ceili(e.hp)),
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, e.r * 2, 48 if e.kind == "boss" else 24)
		for b in bullets:
			draw_circle(b.pos, 6.0, Color("ffd34d"))
		var shooters := _shooters() if state == "wave" else [player_x]
		for x in shooters.slice(1):
			draw_circle(Vector2(x, PLAYER_Y + 10), 18.0, Color("7fa8ff"))
		draw_circle(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R, Color("3d7bff"))
		if shield > 0:
			draw_arc(Vector2(player_x, PLAYER_Y), PLAYER_R + 8, 0, TAU, 32, Color("4ae08a"), 4.0)
		if mini_id != "":
			_draw_cell(Rect2(MINI_POS, Vector2(90, 90)), mini_id)

	if state in ["spin", "draft", "over"]:
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, W, 1280), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
	if state == "spin":
		draw_rect(Rect2(GRID_POS - Vector2(12, 12), Vector2(CELL * 3 + 24, CELL * 3 + 24)), Color("1a1a22"))

			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, W, 24)

content.text:
The game is now harder, power builds up across the whole run, and where symbols land on the reels decides how strong you get. I tested it with simulated bots only. You haven't played it yet.

**What changed:**
- **Luck matters.** Each spin draws 9 cells from a bag of your symbols mixed with empty cells. With the starting 6 symbols the bag has 9 empties, so a spin shows about 4 symbols. Which symbols land, and where, is now random.
- **Combos pay most.** Each matching symbol next to a cell adds ×1 to that cell's payout, and a straight line of 3 of the same doubles it. A lone Bullet gives +1 damage, but three Bullets in a row give +14. Fire also gets ×1 for each Bullet beside it. Three Sevens in a line is a jackpot that triples the whole spin. Cells that scored extra get a yellow outline and an "x2" or "x3" label.
- **Power stacks for the whole run.** Every spin adds to your stats permanently. Stats can be fractions, like "+0.15 bullets", and you get another bullet or ally when the total passes a whole number, so you see numbers climb. Your current DMG, RATE, BULLETS and so on are always on screen.
- **Harder enemies:**
  - Enemy HP multiplies by 1.9 every wave.
  - Enemies drift toward you, so you have to steer and dodge.
  - Your starting damage dropped from 10 to 5.
  - Each wave's starting screen tells you how much enemy HP has grown.
- **Coins buy more spins.** Kills drop coins, and spins cost 5 gold, then 3 more each time. The mini reel chest now pays one random cell ×3 permanently, and it can land on an empty cell.

**Simulation results (5 runs per bot):**

| Bot | Result |
|---|---|
| Never moves, never buys spins | Died by wave 3 every time (once on wave 1) |
| Perfect-aim, ignores dodging, buys every spin it can | Won 4 of 5. Final damage ranged from 195 to 772 depending on luck. Died on wave 1 once. |

The final boss is where the difficulty cliff sits: at 1.8× growth the aim bot won every run, at 2.0× it died to the wave-9 boss every run. A real player won't aim perfectly, so 1.9× will probably feel harder than these numbers suggest. Play a few runs and tell me if it's too hard.

The settings to adjust are `HP_GROWTH`, `BOSS_HP`, `SPIN_COST_START` and `BASE_SPINS` at the top of `scripts/run.gd`, and each symbol's amount in `scripts/symbols.gd`. The combo-scoring tests are in `scripts/symbols_check.gd` and pass.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

content.text:
Here's how I'd fit your ideas together. Summon-and-merge games like Random Dice and Lucky Defense prove the loop works; the characters and art here will be our own.

**Spins as a currency**
- A run starts with 3 spins. Each wave start adds more: +3, then +1 extra every third wave, so the gift grows.
- Chests and coins earn more spins, and unused spins carry over.
- The SPIN button is always available, including mid-wave. The reels spin in a strip at the bottom of the screen and the game keeps running.

**Reels hold both characters and power symbols**
- The power symbols you have now (Bullet, Clock and so on) stay.
- Character symbols summon that unit into your squad when they land.
- Each character has a rarity (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) that sets how often it shows up on the reels.
- The between-wave draft offers new characters and powers.

**Squad instead of a single hero**
- You start with one Swordsman. Summoned units join a formation that you steer like the crowd in your first screenshot.
- Each class fights its own way:

| Character | Rarity | How it fights |
|---|---|---|
| Swordsman | Common | Short-range slash that hits several enemies |
| Archer | Common | Long-range arrows |
| Spearman | Common | Shots pierce through a line of enemies |
| Mage | Rare | Area blast |
| Healer | Rare | Heals the squad |
| Bomber | Rare | Slow, heavy splash damage |
| Knight | Epic | Tank that blocks hits for the squad |
| Assassin | Epic | Fast hits with critical strikes |
| Dragon | Legendary | Breathes fire in a cone |

**Merge to evolve**
- Two of the same character at the same tier make one unit of the next tier, up to tier 5, with roughly double the power per tier.
- A squad limit of about 8 units makes you merge.
- Luck shows up in which characters land and in rarity rolls. Three of the same character on one spin summons it already at tier 2, as a jackpot.

Four choices change how this gets built:

questions.question: Reel layout now that spins can happen mid-wave?

options.label: 1 row x 3 reels (Recommended)
options.description: Classic slot strip at the bottom of the screen. Readable mid-wave, doesn't cover the lane. 3 of a kind = jackpot.

options.label: Keep 3x3 grid
options.description: Deeper combos/adjacency, but must pause or cover the lane when spinning mid-wave.

options.label: 1 row x 5 reels
options.description: More symbols per spin, wider strip, more combo chance; smaller symbols on phone.

questions.question: How should merging work?

options.label: Drag to merge + auto when squad full (Recommended)
options.description: Player drags a unit onto a matching one in the squad bar (any time). If a new summon would overflow the cap, best merge happens automatically.

options.label: Fully automatic
options.description: Any 2 matching units merge instantly. Zero interruption, less player choice.

options.label: Manual only
options.description: Only drag-merge. Overflow summons are lost if squad is full.

questions.question: How does squad health work?

options.label: Each unit has own HP (Recommended)
options.description: Enemy hits the unit it touches; units can die. Lose all = run over. Squad-runner feel, spins refill losses.

options.label: Shared HP bar
options.description: Units never die; one team HP bar like now. Simpler, less tension.

questions.question: Keep the power symbols (Bullet, Clock, Twin...) in the reels alongside characters?

options.label: Keep, as squad-wide buffs (Recommended)
options.description: Power symbols buff all units permanently (dmg, attack speed...). Characters + powers both in the reel bag.

options.label: Characters only
options.description: Reels only summon characters; power comes from merging. Cleaner, one system.

# Run: godot --headless --path . --script scripts/symbols_check.gd

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")


func _initialize() -> void:
	var res := Symbols.resolve(["swordsman", "blank", "archer"])
	assert(res.summons == [["swordsman", 1], ["archer", 1]])

	res = Symbols.resolve(["swordsman", "swordsman", "blank"])
	assert(res.summons == [["swordsman", 1], ["swordsman", 1]] and not res.jackpot)

	res = Symbols.resolve(["mage", "mage", "mage"])
	assert(res.summons == [["mage", 3]] and res.jackpot, "3 of a kind summons tier 3")

	res = Symbols.resolve(["might", "might", "blank"])
	assert(res.buffs.might == 40.0, "pair pays 2 copies x2")
	res = Symbols.resolve(["might", "haste", "blank"])
	assert(res.buffs.might == 10.0 and res.buffs.haste == 8.0)

	res = Symbols.resolve(["seven", "seven", "seven"])
	assert(res.buffs.spins == 5 and res.buffs.gold == 27 and res.jackpot)

	res = Symbols.resolve(["skull", "vigor", "blank"])
	assert(res.buffs.spins == 1 and res.buffs.gold == 5 and is_equal_approx(res.buffs.heal, 0.2))

	assert(Symbols.bag(Symbols.STARTER).size() == Symbols.BAG_MIN)
	for i in 50:
		var r := Symbols.roll(Symbols.STARTER)
		assert(r.size() == 3 and r.all(func(id): return Symbols.DATA.has(id)))
	var offers := Symbols.draft_offers(3)
	assert(offers.size() == 3 and offers[0] != offers[1])
	assert(Symbols.tier_mult(3) == 4.0)
	print("symbols_check ok: ", Symbols.summary(Symbols.resolve(["mage", "might", "might"])))
	quit()

extends SceneTree
# Run: godot --headless --path . --script scripts/symbols_check.gd

const Symbols := preload("res://scripts/symbols.gd")


func _initialize() -> void:
	var _b := "blank"
	# Lone bullet pays base.
	var g := [_b, _b, _b, _b, "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 1.0)

	# Two adjacent bullets: each x2 -> 4. Diagonal does not count.
	g = ["bullet", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 4.0)
	g = ["bullet", _b, _b, _b, "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 2.0)

	# Line of 3: ends have 1 neighbour (x2), middle 2 (x3); line doubles -> (2+3+2)*2 = 14.
	g = ["bullet", "bullet", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).damage == 14.0)

	# Fire next to bullet gets +1 mult.
	g = ["fire", "bullet", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	assert(Symbols.resolve(g).burn == 2.0)

	# Jackpot: 3 sevens in a column triples the spin.
	g = ["seven", "clock", _b, "seven", _b, _b, "seven", _b, _b]
	var b := Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(Symbols.is_jackpot(g) and b.fire_rate == 15.0)

	# Skull: gold, spin, enemy HP.
	g = ["skull", _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b, _b]
	b = Symbols.resolve(g)
	assert(b.gold == 4 and b.spins == 1 and is_equal_approx(b.enemy_hp, 0.05))

	# Bag padding: starter pool always mixes in empties, big pools keep the minimum.
	assert(Symbols.bag(Symbols.STARTER).size() == Symbols.BAG_MIN)
	assert(Symbols.bag(range(20)).count("blank") == Symbols.BLANK_MIN)
	assert(Symbols.roll(Symbols.STARTER).size() == 9)
	print("symbols_check ok")
	quit()

content.text:
The squad version is built. Spins are now a currency you can spend at any time, the reels summon characters, and you merge characters to level them up. It runs without errors in simulated games, but I haven't seen it in a real window, so the layout and drag-to-merge haven't been checked by eye.

**How it plays:**
- **Spins:** you start with 3. Each new wave gives 3 more, plus 1 extra every third wave (3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5…). Gold "SPIN" chests in the lane give +1, and you can buy spins with gold (5 gold, then 5 more each time). Unused spins carry over.
- **Reels:** a 3-reel strip at the bottom. Press SPIN at any time, during a wave or between waves, and the game never pauses.
  - A character symbol summons that unit.
  - Three of the same character summons one already at level 3.
  - Power symbols buff the whole squad permanently: Might (damage), Haste (attack speed), Vigor (HP and a heal), Magnet, Seven (7-7-7 gives +5 spins) and Skull (risk).
- **Squad:** you start with 1 Swordsman. Melee units stand in the front row and shooters at the back.
  - Each unit has its own HP bar and can die. If the whole squad dies, the run is over.
  - Enemies chase the squad, and the boss walks up and attacks the front unit.
- **Merge:** drag a card in the bottom bar onto the same character at the same level to make one unit a level higher, up to level 5. Each level doubles its damage and HP. Valid targets light up yellow. The squad holds 8 units; if a summon would overflow it, the best matching pair merges on its own, and if no pair matches, the new unit is lost.
- **Characters:**

| Rarity | Character | Ability |
|---|---|---|
| Common | Swordsman | Slashes every enemy close in front |
| Common | Archer | Long-range arrows |
| Common | Spearman | Spear pierces 3 enemies |
| Rare | Mage | Area blast |
| Rare | Healer | Heals the most hurt ally |
| Rare | Bomber | Slow, huge explosion |
| Epic | Knight | Tank that cleaves in front |
| Epic | Assassin | Rapid knives that can crit |
| Legendary | Dragon | Rapid splashing fireballs |

- **Draft:** after each wave you pick 1 of 3 offers. They're rolled by rarity (60% Common, 27% Rare, 10% Epic, 3% Legendary) and shown in rarity colours.

**Simulation results (6 runs per bot):**

| Bot | Result |
|---|---|
| Spins but never merges, steers or buys | Died between waves 3 and 9 |
| Spins, buys, merges and chases enemies | Won 3 of 6. Died once on wave 1, because it drives straight into enemies |

After the first simulations I changed a few things:
- Enemy HP growth went from 1.6× to 1.9× per wave, because the bot that merges and buys won every run.
- Spin prices now rise by 5 gold instead of 3.
- The first two waves have fewer enemies.
- The starting Swordsman hits harder: 20 damage instead of 12, slightly slower.
- The boss now follows the squad sideways. Before, steering away caused a stand-off where nothing could hit anything.

**Not done yet:**
- **Art:** everything is still coloured circles and squares with letters.
- **Character cap:** there's no limit on how many character types go in the reels, and no way to remove one.
- **Swordsman dominance:** in the winning runs most of the squad ended up as Swordsmen, because the starting reels hold 3 of them. If you want more variety, the fix is to put fewer Swordsmen in the starting reels.

The settings are at the top of `scripts/run.gd`, and each character's stats are in `scripts/symbols.gd`. `scripts/symbols_check.gd` passes.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

content.text:
I've added five enemy types: three that rush you and two that hang back and shoot. The game runs without script errors in simulations. It's now hard enough that neither bot won a single run. The bots don't dodge, though, so I can't tell how it plays for a real person.

| Enemy | Appears from | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| Grunt (red) | Wave 1 | The current enemy: chases you and hits on contact |
| Runner (orange, small) | Wave 2 | Half HP, nearly twice as fast, chases hard |
| Shooter (pink, yellow ring) | Wave 3 | Stops partway down the lane and fires aimed bolts every 2.2 seconds. You can dodge them by steering. |
| Brute (dark red, big) | Wave 4 | 4× HP, 3× damage, slow: a tank |
| Mortar (purple, yellow ring) | Wave 5 | Stops near the top and lobs shells. A red circle marks where each will land and fills in over 1.2 seconds, so you can move out. |
| Boss | Waves 3, 6, 9 | Now also lobs a big shell every 3.5 seconds |

- **Rows mix types.** Each row has a random mix of the types unlocked so far, and when a new type first appears the wave banner says "New enemy: …".
- **Shooters and Mortars always come close in the end.** After stopping they still creep forward slowly, so an all-melee squad can eventually reach them. Ranged units like Archers and Mages deal with them much faster, which gives a reason to draft them.
- **Starting reels changed.** One of the three Swordsmen is now an Archer, so you can fight ranged enemies from the start and the squad isn't almost all Swordsmen.

**Difficulty from simulations (6 runs per bot):**

| Bot | Result |
|---|---|
| Spins but never merges, steers or buys | Died on waves 3 to 5 |
| Spins, buys, merges, chases enemies, never dodges | Died on waves 3 to 9, no wins |

The first version made wave 3 a wall for both bots, so I made these changes:

- The boss's shells now do 40% of its melee hit instead of a full hit, and fire every 3.5 seconds instead of 3.
- Shooters fire every 2.2 seconds instead of 1.6.
- Mortars do 0.8× damage instead of 1.5× and fire every 3.5 seconds.
- Enemy HP growth went from 1.9× to 1.8× per wave.

Since dodging should be how you survive the ranged enemies, please play a few runs and tell me where it feels unfair. The enemy settings are in `ENEMY_TYPES` near the top of `scripts/run.gd`.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

content.text:
Your game is a top-down view of a lane that scrolls downward, so look for top-down 2D art. The most important rule is to pick one art style and one tile size (usually 16×16 or 32×32 pixel art) and take the road, environment, characters and enemies from the same pack or artist. Mixing styles looks bad fast.

**Packs that fit this game (from memory, so check each page):**

| Pack | Where | Why it fits | License, as I remember it |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny Swords by Pixel Frog | itch.io | Top-down fantasy terrain and roads plus warriors, archers, goblins and towers. Fits your Swordsman and Archer. | Free. Check its terms. |
| Ninja Adventure Asset Pack by Pixel-boy | itch.io | Huge 16×16 set: terrain, roads, trees, characters, monsters, effects, even music and sounds | CC0 |
| Kenney: Tiny Town, Tiny Dungeon, Roguelike/RPG Pack | kenney.nl | Clean 16×16 tiles for grass, paths, trees and fences | CC0 |
| Kenney Racing Pack | kenney.nl | Proper top-down road tiles, if you want an actual road rather than a dirt path | CC0 |

**Search terms (itch.io free assets, OpenGameArt, kenney.nl):**
- Road and lane: `top down road tileset`, `top down path tileset`, `vertical scrolling background`, `seamless top down ground texture`
- Environment: `top down forest tileset`, `top down fantasy tileset 16x16`, `pixel art trees rocks top down`, `top down grass tileset`
- Props along the lane edges: `top down props pixel`, `fence barrel crate pixel`
- Effects: `pixel explosion spritesheet`, `slash effect pixel`, `magic projectile pixel`

**Licenses:**
- **CC0** (Kenney, Ninja Adventure): use freely, no credit needed.
- **CC-BY:** fine, but you must credit the author. Keep a `CREDITS.md` as you go.
- **CC-BY-SA or GPL** (common on OpenGameArt, such as the LPC sets): these can impose share-alike terms on your own work. Avoid them unless you're comfortable with that.
- **"Free for personal use" or "non-commercial":** skip these if you might ever sell the game.
- Never use ripped sprites from real games.

**How this maps onto the current game:**
- **Road:** one seamless vertical tile that repeats and scrolls. In Godot that's a `Parallax2D` with `repeat_size`, or a `TextureRect` with repeating texture and a scrolling offset. It replaces the grey lane rectangle.
- **Sides:** a grass or forest strip that scrolls with the road, plus trees and rocks placed randomly along the edges.
- **Reel symbols:** these can reuse the character portraits or icons from the same pack.

Once you've downloaded a pack, put it in `assets/` and I'll wire in the road, the sides and the sprites.

671			HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, rect.size.x, int(rect.size.y * 0.38), Color.BLACK)

678		var d := _d(u)
679		var r: float = UNIT_R + (u.tier - 1) * 2.5
680		draw_circle(pos, r, d.color)
681		draw_arc(pos, r, 0, TAU, 24, Symbols.RARITY_COLOR[d.rarity], 3.0)
682		draw_string(font, pos + Vector2(-r, 7), d.letter, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, r * 2, 20, Color.BLACK)
683		if u.tier > 1:
684			draw_string(font, pos + Vector2(-r, -r - 4), str(u.tier), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, r * 2, 18, Color("ffe14d"))
685		var frac: float = clampf(u.hp / _max_hp(u), 0, 1)
686		draw_rect(Rect2(pos + Vector2(-r, r + 3), Vector2(r * 2, 4)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))

697		for coin in coins:

699		for e in enemies:

702			if e.kind == "chest":
703				draw_rect(Rect2(e.pos - Vector2(e.r, e.r), Vector2(e.r, e.r) * 2), col)

content.text:
The game now uses the Tiny Swords art. I extracted the pack into `assets/tiny_swords/` and recorded the game to check it. Grass, trees, units and enemies all draw correctly, and the bot simulations ran with no errors.

**What's in:**
- **Ground:** the lane is a scrolling grass path over water. Tiny Swords has no road tile, so the squad marches along a grassy causeway. Pine trees on the banks, bushes along the lane edges and rocks in the water scroll past.
- **Your squad (blue team):**

| Character | Sprite |
|---|---|
| Swordsman | Blue Warrior |
| Archer | Blue Archer |
| Spearman | Blue Lancer |
| Healer | Blue Monk |
| Mage | Purple Monk |
| Assassin | Purple Archer |
| Knight | Black Warrior |
| Bomber | Yellow Pawn with hammer |

  Higher-level units are drawn slightly bigger.
- **Enemies (red team):**

| Enemy | Sprite |
|---|---|
| Grunt | Red Pawn with hammer |
| Runner | Small red Pawn |
| Shooter | Red Archer |
| Brute | Big red Warrior |
| Mortar | Red Monk |
| Boss | Big red Lancer |

  Enemies turn to face your squad, and their HP numbers have an outline so they're readable.
- **Effects and pickups:**
  - Archers and Assassins fire real arrow sprites, and enemy Shooters fire red arrows.
  - Blasts and mortar shells use the pack's explosion animation.
  - Coins are gold nuggets, and spin chests are gold stones.
- **Reels and squad bar:** character symbols show the character's portrait. Power symbols (Might, Haste and so on) are still coloured squares with letters, because the pack has no matching icons.

**Choices you might want to change:**
- **Dragon is now "Champion".** The pack has no dragon, so the legendary unit became a golden Lancer with the same stats.
- **Mage and Bomber are stand-ins.** They use a recoloured Monk and Pawn. A wizard sprite would fit the Mage better.
- **Pixel-art settings:** I set nearest-neighbour filtering so the pixel art stays crisp, and widened the lane slightly (from 600px to 640px) so it fits the grass tiles exactly.
- **Bigger sprites:** after the first recording, I made units bigger and spaced them out more.
- **Cleanup:** I deleted the macOS junk files (`__MACOSX/`, `.DS_Store`) that came out of the zip, because they caused import errors.

**License:** I added `CREDITS.md` crediting Pixel Frog. Check the Tiny Swords page on itch.io for the exact terms before you publish.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`. With no input the lone Swordsman dies on wave 1, so press SPIN early.

content.text:
I fixed both problems and recorded about 50 seconds of a bot playing to check them. Trees now draw correctly and units visibly attack, with no errors.

**Trees sliding sideways:** the two big pine-tree sheets have frames 192px wide on a 256px-tall image. My code assumed square frames, so it cut each frame from the wrong place and the tree appeared to drift. Those two sheets now use the right frame width, so trees only sway in place.

**Character animation:** units used to play their running animation nonstop, even while fighting. Now each attack plays a short one-off animation (0.4s, set by `ATTACK_ANIM` in `scripts/run.gd`):

| Character | Attack animation |
|---|---|
| Swordsman, Knight | Sword swing |
| Archer, Assassin | Bow draw |
| Spearman, Champion | Upward lance thrust |
| Healer, Mage | Casting |
| Bomber | Hammer swing |

- **Enemies:** Shooters play their bow animation, Mortars their casting animation, and the boss a downward lance strike.
- **Enemy facing:** enemies stop flipping left and right when they're lined up with your squad.
- **Between waves:** units and enemies stand still instead of running in place.

In the recording, the Archer is caught mid-shot and the Swordsmen march normally. I only looked at single frames, so play it to judge how the motion feels. If attacks look too fast or too slow, change `ATTACK_ANIM`.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

content.text:
The whole UI is now built from the Tiny Swords UI art. I recorded gameplay and the draft screen and checked the frames, and the bot simulations ran with no errors.

**What changed:**
- **Top bar:**
  - A blue ribbon shows "WAVE 1/9" (plus "BOSS" on boss waves).
  - A gold coin icon and count sit on the left, and a sword icon with the squad count on the right.
  - The wave progress bar is now the pack's wooden bar with a red fill.
- **Wave messages:** "+1 spin", jackpots and new-enemy warnings appear on a yellow ribbon, and only during waves, so they don't cover the draft.
- **Bottom panel:** a wooden table with three cream paper reel cells inside a dark frame with gold corners, a big red SPIN button, a blue "+1 spin" buy button and wooden squad slots.
  - Buttons look pressed when clicked, brighten on hover and grey out when disabled.
- **Reel symbols:**
  - Power symbols use the pack's icons: sword for Might, green arrow for Haste, meat for Vigor, coin for Magnet, red X for Skull.
  - Seven is a big pink "7".
  - Rare and better symbols get a coloured border.
- **Draft screen:** a "Add to your reels" ribbon and three parchment cards, each with a portrait on paper, the name and description in dark ink, and a rarity ribbon: black for Common, blue for Rare, purple for Epic, gold for Legendary.
- **Game over:** shown on a parchment banner with a red Restart button.
- **Effects:** sword slashes and merges are now thin fading rings instead of big flat circles.

The pack's panel art couldn't be stretched as shipped, so `tools/pack_ui.gd` repacks it into `assets/ui/`. You'd only rerun it if you swap the source art: `godot --headless --path . --script tools/pack_ui.gd`.

The biggest remaining visual improvement would be a pixel font, since the text still uses Godot's default font. Pixelify Sans (free on Google Fonts) would match this art. Download it into `assets/` and I'll wire it in.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

content.text:
Tiny Swords has no audio, so you'll need separate packs. Pick a medieval or fantasy sound plus some casino sounds for the slot machine. These are the best free sources I know of; check each page for the exact license.

**Easiest place to start (no credit required):**

| Source | What to grab |
|---|---|
| **kenney.nl/assets** (audio category, CC0) | **Casino Audio** (chips, coins, card sounds: good for spins and gold), **RPG Audio** (sword, footsteps, armour), **Impact Sounds** (hits), **Interface Sounds** / **UI Audio** (button clicks), **Music Jingles** (short win, lose and level-up stings) |
| **Ninja Adventure Asset Pack** (itch.io, CC0) | Comes with full music tracks and many sound effects (sword, bow, magic, coins, menu) in a matching retro fantasy style |
| **OpenGameArt.org** | Search "fantasy battle music loop", "medieval music", "8-bit RPG music". Juhani Junkala's game music packs are CC0. Filter by license, because many entries are CC-BY-SA or GPL |

**Larger libraries (check each file's license):**
- **Freesound.org:** huge, with a license filter. Set it to CC0. Search terms: `slot machine reel`, `reel stop`, `coin pickup`, `sword slash`, `bow release`, `war horn`.
- **Pixabay** (sound effects and music): free for commercial use under the Pixabay license, no credit required.
- **Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle:** gigabytes of professional royalty-free sound effects, released free every year.
- **incompetech.com (Kevin MacLeod):** lots of fantasy and battle music, CC-BY, so you must credit him.

**Make your own sound effects (free tools):** jsfxr (in the browser), ChipTone or rFXGen. You click "pickup", "hit" or "explosion" and export a WAV. These are great for retro coin, hit and level-up blips.

**Sounds this game needs:**

| Moment | Sound | Search term |
|---|---|---|

**Format and licenses:**

- Prefer **CC0**. For **CC-BY**, add the author to `CREDITS.md`. Avoid **CC-BY-SA**, GPL and "non-commercial" if you might sell the game.

# at random with a small pitch wobble so repeated sounds don't feel robotic.
# To swap a sound, edit the paths here. Jingle choices were picked by length, not by ear.

const DIR := "res://assets/audio/"
const C := "casino-audio/Audio/"
const R := "rpg-audio/Audio/"
const I := "interface-sounds/Audio/"
const H := "impact-sounds/Audio/"
const J := "music-jingles/Audio/"

const SOUNDS := {
	# slot machine
	spin = [C + "dice-shake-1.ogg", C + "dice-shake-2.ogg", C + "dice-shake-3.ogg"],
	reel_stop = [C + "chip-lay-1.ogg", C + "chip-lay-2.ogg", C + "chip-lay-3.ogg"],
	jackpot = [J + "Pizzicato jingles/jingles_PIZZI07.ogg"],
	buy = [C + "chips-handle-1.ogg", C + "chips-handle-2.ogg", C + "chips-handle-3.ogg"],
	coin = [C + "chips-collide-1.ogg", C + "chips-collide-2.ogg", C + "chips-collide-3.ogg", C + "chips-collide-4.ogg"],
	chest = [C + "chips-stack-1.ogg", C + "chips-stack-2.ogg", C + "chips-stack-3.ogg"],
	# squad
	merge = [I + "maximize_006.ogg"],
	slash = [R + "knifeSlice.ogg", R + "knifeSlice2.ogg", R + "drawKnife1.ogg"],
	bow = [I + "pluck_001.ogg", I + "pluck_002.ogg"],
	throw = [R + "cloth1.ogg", R + "cloth2.ogg", R + "cloth3.ogg"],
	heal = [I + "glass_001.ogg", I + "glass_002.ogg", I + "glass_003.ogg"],
	unit_die = [H + "impactBell_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactBell_heavy_001.ogg"],
	# combat
	hit = [H + "impactSoft_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_002.ogg"],
	boom = [H + "impactPunch_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_001.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_002.ogg"],
	hurt = [H + "impactPlate_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_002.ogg"],
	enemy_die = [H + "impactWood_light_000.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_001.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_002.ogg"],
	launch = [I + "drop_001.ogg", I + "drop_002.ogg"],
	# flow
	wave = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL07.ogg"],
	boss = [J + "Hit jingles/jingles_HIT15.ogg"],
	draft = [R + "bookOpen.ogg"],
	pick = [R + "bookPlace1.ogg", R + "bookPlace2.ogg"],
	error = [I + "error_004.ogg"],
	win = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL01.ogg"],
	lose = [J + "Sax jingles/jingles_SAX07.ogg"],
}
const VOLUME := {coin = -10.0, hit = -12.0, enemy_die = -10.0, bow = -8.0, slash = -6.0, throw = -8.0, spin = -4.0}
const MIN_GAP := 0.07   # seconds before the same sound may retrigger (stops arrow/coin spam)
const VOICES := 16

var _players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []
var _last := {}
var _cache := {}


func _ready() -> void:
	for i in VOICES:
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		add_child(p)
		_players.append(p)


func play(name: String, pitch := 1.0) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
	if now - _last.get(name, -1.0) < MIN_GAP:
		return
	_last[name] = now
	var path: String = SOUNDS[name].pick_random()
	if not _cache.has(path):
		_cache[path] = load(DIR + path)
	var player := _players[0]
	for p in _players:
		if not p.playing:
			player = p
			break
	player.stream = _cache[path]
	player.volume_db = VOLUME.get(name, 0.0)
	player.pitch_scale = pitch * randf_range(0.93, 1.07)
	player.play()

content.text:
Sound effects are in. I ran the game for 30 seconds with audio and the bot simulations, with no errors. I haven't heard the result myself, so the choices are by name and length, not by ear. There is still no background music, because none of the five packs includes a looping track.

The five Kenney packs (casino, impact, RPG, interface, music jingles) are extracted to `assets/audio/` and are CC0, so no credit is required. I added them to `CREDITS.md` anyway.

**What plays when:**

| Moment | Sound |
|---|---|
| SPIN pressed | Dice rattle |
| Reels land | Chip clack |
| Jackpot | Pizzicato jingle |
| Buy spin | Chips shuffled |
| Coin pickup | Chip clink |
| Spin chest opened | Chips stacking |
| Merge | Rising chime |
| Swordsman / Knight attack | Blade swish |
| Archer / Spearman / Assassin shot | Bowstring pluck |
| Mage / Bomber / Champion throw | Cloth whoosh, then a heavy thump when it explodes |
| Healer | Glass chime |
| Arrow hits enemy | Soft impact |
| Enemy dies | Wood knock |
| Unit hurt | Metal plate hit |
| Unit dies | Bell toll |
| Enemy Shooter fires | Lower-pitched pluck |
| Mortar launches / shell lands | Drop sound / heavy thump |
| Wave start | Steel-drum jingle |
| Boss wave start | Hit jingle |
| Draft opens / symbol picked | Book opens / book placed |
| Invalid merge, unit lost to a full squad | Error buzz |
| Win / lose | Steel jingle / sax jingle |

- **Variety:** each sound picks a random variant with a slight pitch change, so repeats don't sound robotic.
- **No spam:** the same sound can't retrigger within 0.07 seconds, so a volley of arrows doesn't become noise. Frequent sounds (coins, hits, plucks) are turned down.

All mappings are in one table in `scripts/sfx.gd`. If a sound feels wrong, swap the file path there, and adjust levels in the `VOLUME` table.

The first run failed because Godot hadn't imported the new sounds yet; a second import fixed it. The remaining "Sony Ogg Vorbis" warnings are harmless metadata notices from Kenney's files.

For music, download a looping battle track and optionally a heavier boss track (for example "fantasy battle loop" on OpenGameArt or Pixabay), and I'll add a music player that switches tracks on boss waves.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

# Sound effects from Kenney CC0 packs in assets/audio. Each name maps to variants; one is picked
# at random with a small pitch wobble so repeated sounds don't feel robotic.
# To swap a sound, edit the paths here. Jingle choices were picked by length, not by ear.

const DIR := "res://assets/audio/"
const C := "casino-audio/Audio/"
const R := "rpg-audio/Audio/"
const I := "interface-sounds/Audio/"
const H := "impact-sounds/Audio/"
const J := "music-jingles/Audio/"

const SOUNDS := {
	# slot machine
	spin = [C + "dice-shake-1.ogg", C + "dice-shake-2.ogg", C + "dice-shake-3.ogg"],
	reel_stop = [C + "chip-lay-1.ogg", C + "chip-lay-2.ogg", C + "chip-lay-3.ogg"],
	jackpot = [J + "Pizzicato jingles/jingles_PIZZI07.ogg"],
	buy = [C + "chips-handle-1.ogg", C + "chips-handle-2.ogg", C + "chips-handle-3.ogg"],
	coin = [C + "chips-collide-1.ogg", C + "chips-collide-2.ogg", C + "chips-collide-3.ogg", C + "chips-collide-4.ogg"],
	chest = [C + "chips-stack-1.ogg", C + "chips-stack-2.ogg", C + "chips-stack-3.ogg"],
	# squad
	merge = [I + "maximize_006.ogg"],
	slash = [R + "knifeSlice.ogg", R + "knifeSlice2.ogg", R + "drawKnife1.ogg"],
	bow = [I + "pluck_001.ogg", I + "pluck_002.ogg"],
	throw = [R + "cloth1.ogg", R + "cloth2.ogg", R + "cloth3.ogg"],
	heal = [I + "glass_001.ogg", I + "glass_002.ogg", I + "glass_003.ogg"],
	unit_die = [H + "impactBell_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactBell_heavy_001.ogg"],
	# combat
	hit = [H + "impactSoft_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_002.ogg"],
	boom = [H + "impactPunch_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_001.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_002.ogg"],
	hurt = [H + "impactPlate_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_002.ogg"],
	enemy_die = [H + "impactWood_light_000.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_001.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_002.ogg"],
	launch = [I + "drop_001.ogg", I + "drop_002.ogg"],
	# flow
	wave = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL07.ogg"],
	boss = [J + "Hit jingles/jingles_HIT15.ogg"],
	draft = [R + "bookOpen.ogg"],
	pick = [R + "bookPlace1.ogg", R + "bookPlace2.ogg"],
	error = [I + "error_004.ogg"],
	win = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL01.ogg"],
	lose = [J + "Sax jingles/jingles_SAX07.ogg"],
}
const VOLUME := {coin = -10.0, hit = -12.0, enemy_die = -10.0, bow = -8.0, slash = -6.0, throw = -8.0, spin = -4.0}
const MIN_GAP := 0.07   # seconds before the same sound may retrigger (stops arrow/coin spam)
const VOICES := 16

var _players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []
var _last := {}
var _cache := {}


func _ready() -> void:
	for i in VOICES:
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		add_child(p)
		_players.append(p)


func play(name: String, pitch := 1.0) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
	if now - _last.get(name, -1.0) < MIN_GAP:
		return
	_last[name] = now
	var path: String = SOUNDS[name].pick_random()
	if not _cache.has(path):
		_cache[path] = load(DIR + path)
	var player := _players[0]
	for p in _players:
		if not p.playing:
			player = p
			break
	player.stream = _cache[path]
	player.volume_db = VOLUME.get(name, 0.0)
	player.pitch_scale = pitch * randf_range(0.93, 1.07)
	player.play()

The music is in: `8BitBattleLoop.ogg` loops in the background through every wave and the draft screen. I copied it to `assets/audio/music/`.

- **Volume:** it plays 10 dB below the sound effects so slashes and coins still come through. Change `MUSIC_DB` in `scripts/sfx.gd` if it's too quiet or loud.
- **Game over:** the music stops so the win or lose jingle is heard clearly. It restarts when you press Restart.

I ran the game for 30 seconds with a bot playing and nothing errored during play. When the test run was force-closed, Godot reported "4 ObjectDB instances leaked" and "2 resources still in use at exit". That's new since adding music, and I didn't track it down. It only appears on that forced shutdown and doesn't affect gameplay.

**License:** I don't know where this track came from, so I couldn't add it to `CREDITS.md`. If it's CC-BY, tell me the author and source and I'll add the credit.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

func _build_settings() -> void:
	gear_btn = TextureButton.new()
	gear_btn.texture_normal = Art.tex(Art.ICON_GEAR)
	gear_btn.ignore_texture_size = true
	gear_btn.stretch_mode = TextureButton.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	gear_btn.position = GEAR_RECT.position
	gear_btn.size = GEAR_RECT.size
	gear_btn.pressed.connect(_toggle_settings)
	ui.add_child(gear_btn)

	var blocker := Control.new()  # swallows clicks meant for things under the panel
	blocker.position = Vector2.ZERO
	blocker.size = Vector2(W, 1280)
	blocker.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	ui.add_child(blocker)
	settings_ui.append(blocker)

	var title := _label(SETTINGS_RIBBON.position, SETTINGS_RIBBON.size, 32)
	title.text = "SETTINGS"
	settings_ui.append(title)

	var track := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	track.bg_color = Color("6b4a2b")
	track.set_corner_radius_all(6)
	track.content_margin_top = 7
	track.content_margin_bottom = 7
	var fill: StyleBoxFlat = track.duplicate()
	fill.bg_color = Color("e0b040")
	var knob_img := Art.tex(Art.ICON_COIN).get_image()
	knob_img.resize(40, 40, Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
	var knob := ImageTexture.create_from_image(knob_img)

	for i in sfx.BUSES.size():
		var bus: String = sfx.BUSES[i]
		var y: float = SETTINGS_RECT.position.y + 80 + i * 85
		var l := _label(Vector2(105, y), Vector2(150, 56), 26)

# Opens settings, mutes SFX, changes music volume; prints bus state and save file.
var run
var n := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	run = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(run)


func _process(_delta: float) -> bool:
	n += 1
	if n == 5:
		run._toggle_settings()
		run.settings_toggles["SFX"].button_pressed = false   # emits toggled -> mute
		run.sfx.set_volume("Music", 0.5)
	if n == 15:
		for bus in ["Master", "Music", "SFX"]:
			var i := AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus)
			print(bus, " idx=", i, " db=", snappedf(AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(i), 0.1), " mute=", AudioServer.is_bus_mute(i))
		print(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("user://settings.cfg"))
		print("paused distance stays: ", run.distance)
	if n == 25:
		print("distance after 10 more frames: ", run.distance)
		run.settings_toggles["SFX"].button_pressed = true
		run.sfx.set_volume("Music", 0.8)
	return false

content.text:
Sound settings are in, and I tested them by driving the panel from a script:

- **Opening the panel:** tap the gear icon in the top-left corner, under the gold count. The game pauses while it's open (the wave doesn't move) and resumes when you press Close.
- **Three rows:** Master, Music and Sound FX. Each has:
  - a slider (a coin is the handle) from silent to full volume;
  - an ON/OFF button, blue when on and red when off, to mute that channel instantly while remembering the slider setting.
- **Music keeps playing** while the panel is open, so you hear volume changes right away.
- **Settings are saved** to `user://settings.cfg` and restored on the next launch.

**Test results:** turning Sound FX OFF muted the SFX channel, setting Music to 50% lowered it by 6 dB, and both were written to the save file. Afterwards I set them back to the defaults (Music 80%, everything on).

The same "leaked at exit" notice from last time appeared again when the test run was force-closed. It's still harmless and only shows on that forced shutdown.

The sound code is in `scripts/sfx.gd` and the panel is in `_build_settings()` in `scripts/run.gd`.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

# Sound effects from Kenney CC0 packs in assets/audio. Each name maps to variants; one is picked
# at random with a small pitch wobble so repeated sounds don't feel robotic.
# To swap a sound, edit the paths here. Jingle choices were picked by length, not by ear.

const DIR := "res://assets/audio/"
const C := "casino-audio/Audio/"
const R := "rpg-audio/Audio/"
const I := "interface-sounds/Audio/"
const H := "impact-sounds/Audio/"
const J := "music-jingles/Audio/"

const SOUNDS := {
	# slot machine
	spin = [C + "dice-shake-1.ogg", C + "dice-shake-2.ogg", C + "dice-shake-3.ogg"],
	reel_stop = [C + "chip-lay-1.ogg", C + "chip-lay-2.ogg", C + "chip-lay-3.ogg"],
	jackpot = [J + "Pizzicato jingles/jingles_PIZZI07.ogg"],
	buy = [C + "chips-handle-1.ogg", C + "chips-handle-2.ogg", C + "chips-handle-3.ogg"],
	coin = [C + "chips-collide-1.ogg", C + "chips-collide-2.ogg", C + "chips-collide-3.ogg", C + "chips-collide-4.ogg"],
	chest = [C + "chips-stack-1.ogg", C + "chips-stack-2.ogg", C + "chips-stack-3.ogg"],
	# squad
	merge = [I + "maximize_006.ogg"],
	slash = [R + "knifeSlice.ogg", R + "knifeSlice2.ogg", R + "drawKnife1.ogg"],
	bow = [I + "pluck_001.ogg", I + "pluck_002.ogg"],
	throw = [R + "cloth1.ogg", R + "cloth2.ogg", R + "cloth3.ogg"],
	heal = [I + "glass_001.ogg", I + "glass_002.ogg", I + "glass_003.ogg"],
	unit_die = [H + "impactBell_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactBell_heavy_001.ogg"],
	# combat
	hit = [H + "impactSoft_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactSoft_medium_002.ogg"],
	boom = [H + "impactPunch_heavy_000.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_001.ogg", H + "impactPunch_heavy_002.ogg"],
	hurt = [H + "impactPlate_medium_000.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_001.ogg", H + "impactPlate_medium_002.ogg"],
	enemy_die = [H + "impactWood_light_000.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_001.ogg", H + "impactWood_light_002.ogg"],
	launch = [I + "drop_001.ogg", I + "drop_002.ogg"],
	# flow
	wave = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL07.ogg"],
	boss = [J + "Hit jingles/jingles_HIT15.ogg"],
	draft = [R + "bookOpen.ogg"],
	pick = [R + "bookPlace1.ogg", R + "bookPlace2.ogg"],
	error = [I + "error_004.ogg"],
	win = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL01.ogg"],
	lose = [J + "Sax jingles/jingles_SAX07.ogg"],
}
const VOLUME := {coin = -10.0, hit = -12.0, enemy_die = -10.0, bow = -8.0, slash = -6.0, throw = -8.0, spin = -4.0}
const MIN_GAP := 0.07   # seconds before the same sound may retrigger (stops arrow/coin spam)
const VOICES := 16

const MUSIC := "music/8BitBattleLoop.ogg"
const MUSIC_DB := -10.0
const SAVE_PATH := "user://settings.cfg"
const BUSES := ["Master", "Music", "SFX"]

# Player-facing volume settings, saved to SAVE_PATH. volume 0..1, on = not muted.
var volume := {Master = 1.0, Music = 0.8, SFX = 1.0}
var enabled := {Master = true, Music = true, SFX = true}

var _players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []
var _last := {}
var _cache := {}
var _music := AudioStreamPlayer.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	for bus in BUSES:
		if AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus) == -1:
			AudioServer.add_bus()
			AudioServer.set_bus_name(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, bus)
			AudioServer.set_bus_send(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, "Master")
	_load_settings()
	for i in VOICES:
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		p.bus = "SFX"
		add_child(p)
		_players.append(p)
	var track: AudioStreamOggVorbis = load(DIR + MUSIC)
	track.loop = true
	_music.stream = track
	_music.volume_db = MUSIC_DB
	_music.bus = "Music"
	add_child(_music)
	_music.play()


func set_volume(bus: String, v: float) -> void:
	volume[bus] = v
	_apply(bus)
	_save_settings()


func set_enabled(bus: String, on: bool) -> void:
	enabled[bus] = on
	_apply(bus)
	_save_settings()


func _apply(bus: String) -> void:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus)
	AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(maxf(volume[bus], 0.0001)))
	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, not enabled[bus] or volume[bus] <= 0.0)


func _load_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	cfg.load(SAVE_PATH)  # missing file on first run is fine: defaults stay
	for bus in BUSES:
		volume[bus] = clampf(cfg.get_value("volume", bus, volume[bus]), 0.0, 1.0)
		enabled[bus] = cfg.get_value("enabled", bus, enabled[bus])
		_apply(bus)


func _save_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	for bus in BUSES:
		cfg.set_value("volume", bus, volume[bus])
		cfg.set_value("enabled", bus, enabled[bus])
	cfg.save(SAVE_PATH)


func stop_music() -> void:
	_music.stop()


func play(name: String, pitch := 1.0) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
	if now - _last.get(name, -1.0) < MIN_GAP:
		return
	_last[name] = now
	var path: String = SOUNDS[name].pick_random()
	if not _cache.has(path):
		_cache[path] = load(DIR + path)
	var player := _players[0]
	for p in _players:
		if not p.playing:
			player = p
			break
	player.stream = _cache[path]
	player.volume_db = VOLUME.get(name, 0.0)
	player.pitch_scale = pitch * randf_range(0.93, 1.07)
	player.play()

content.text:
I rebuilt the spin. A recorded spin shows real scrolling reels, cut off cleanly at the paper frame, stopping left to right. No errors. I could only check frames, not sound, so give it a listen.

The itch.io page didn't show how Slot Tactics spins: the game runs in an embed the fetch couldn't open, and there's no devlog. I built the standard satisfying slot-machine feel with your Kenney sounds instead of copying theirs.

**How a spin plays now:**
1. **Lever pull:** pressing SPIN plays a metal latch clack and all three reels start scrolling.
2. **Scrolling reels:** each reel runs a strip of random symbols from your bag, fast at first and then slowing down, with a quiet tick as each symbol passes. Each reel ticks at a slightly higher pitch than the one before.
3. **Staggered stops:** reels stop left to right, about 0.3 seconds apart. Each lands with a chip thunk, overshoots a little and settles back.
4. **Suspense:** if the first two reels land on the same symbol, a question sound plays and the last reel spins almost a second longer.
5. **Result:**
   - Matching symbols pulse with a gold border for about 1.4 seconds.
   - A pair plays a short pizzicato jingle, and three of a kind plays the jackpot jingle.
   - Summons and power-ups apply once the last reel stops.
6. **Fast stop:** while reels spin, the button reads **STOP**. Tapping it slams them to a halt, for when you have lots of banked spins.

While spinning, the top and bottom of each reel are shaded so they look like curved drums.

**Settings:** the spin speed, stagger, suspense time, bounce and glow are constants starting at `REEL_TIME` in `scripts/run.gd`. Sound choices are in `scripts/sfx.gd`.

**Balance:** a spin now takes about 1.4 seconds instead of 0.6, so spending a big stack of spins takes longer unless you use STOP.

To play, run `godot --path C:\Users\Braindigit\dev\sootingslot`.

const MIN_GAP := 0.07   # seconds before the same sound may retrigger (stops arrow/coin spam)
const VOICES := 16

const MUSIC := "music/8BitBattleLoop.ogg"
const MUSIC_DB := -10.0
const SAVE_PATH := "user://settings.cfg"
const BUSES := ["Master", "Music", "SFX"]

# Player-facing volume settings, saved to SAVE_PATH. volume 0..1, on = not muted.
var volume := {Master = 1.0, Music = 0.8, SFX = 1.0}
var enabled := {Master = true, Music = true, SFX = true}

var _players: Array[AudioStreamPlayer] = []
var _last := {}
var _cache := {}
var _music := AudioStreamPlayer.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	for bus in BUSES:
		if AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus) == -1:
			AudioServer.add_bus()
			AudioServer.set_bus_name(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, bus)
			AudioServer.set_bus_send(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, "Master")
	_load_settings()
	for i in VOICES:
		var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
		p.bus = "SFX"
		add_child(p)
		_players.append(p)
	var track: AudioStreamOggVorbis = load(DIR + MUSIC)
	track.loop = true
	_music.stream = track
	_music.volume_db = MUSIC_DB
	_music.bus = "Music"
	add_child(_music)
	_music.play()


func set_volume(bus: String, v: float) -> void:
	volume[bus] = v
	_apply(bus)
	_save_settings()


func set_enabled(bus: String, on: bool) -> void:
	enabled[bus] = on
	_apply(bus)
	_save_settings()


func _apply(bus: String) -> void:
	var idx := AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus)
	AudioServer.set_bus_volume_db(idx, linear_to_db(maxf(volume[bus], 0.0001)))
	AudioServer.set_bus_mute(idx, not enabled[bus] or volume[bus] <= 0.0)


func _load_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	cfg.load(SAVE_PATH)  # missing file on first run is fine: defaults stay
	for bus in BUSES:
		volume[bus] = clampf(cfg.get_value("volume", bus, volume[bus]), 0.0, 1.0)
		enabled[bus] = cfg.get_value("enabled", bus, enabled[bus])
		_apply(bus)


func _save_settings() -> void:
	var cfg := ConfigFile.new()
	for bus in BUSES:
		cfg.set_value("volume", bus, volume[bus])
		cfg.set_value("enabled", bus, enabled[bus])
	cfg.save(SAVE_PATH)


func stop_music() -> void:
	_music.stop()


func play(name: String, pitch := 1.0) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec() / 1000.0
	if now - _last.get(name, -1.0) < MIN_GAP:
		return
	_last[name] = now
	var path: String = SOUNDS[name].pick_random()
	if not _cache.has(path):
		_cache[path] = load(DIR + path)
	var player := _players[0]
	for p in _players:
		if not p.playing:
			player = p
			break
	player.stream = _cache[path]
	player.volume_db = VOLUME.get(name, 0.0)
	player.pitch_scale = pitch * randf_range(0.93, 1.07)
	player.play()

I replaced the sword sound. The game runs with it without errors, but I can't hear audio here, so check whether it sounds right.

The old sound used the RPG pack's knife-slice files, which is why it sounded like a knife. Swordsman and Knight hits now play two sounds together:
- a soft cloth whoosh for the swing, picked from 4 variants;
- a light metal clang on impact, picked from 5 variants and pitched slightly lower so it sounds like a heavier blade.

Both are mixed quieter than the old slash, so a fight with many sword hits shouldn't get harsh.

If it's still not right, there are two easy changes in `scripts/sfx.gd`:
- **Heavier:** swap the clang to the `impactPlate_light` files, a duller armour thud.
- **Volume:** adjust `swing` and `clang` in the `VOLUME` table.

The Kenney packs have no true sword-swing sound. For a proper "shing", search Freesound with the CC0 filter for `sword swing`, drop the file in `assets/audio/`, and I'll wire it in.

content.text:
The game is installed on your phone and running full screen. I checked it with a screenshot taken from the phone over adb.

The first install had two problems, now fixed:
- **Grey strip at the bottom.** Your phone's screen is taller than the 720×1280 layout. The lane now stretches to the screen height and the wooden spin and squad panel sits on the bottom edge. The PC version still looks the same.
- **Flickering lines** across the reels and lane. These were rendering glitches from Godot's Mobile (Vulkan) renderer on this phone. Android now uses the Compatibility (OpenGL) renderer, and the lines are gone. PC still uses the Mobile renderer.

**Setup changes I made:**
- Installed Godot's Android export templates for 4.7.2. I extracted only the Android files to `%APPDATA%\Godot\export_templates\4.7.2.stable\`. The full 1.3 GB download is still in my scratch folder and can be deleted.
- Added `export_presets.cfg`: an arm64 APK, package `com.sootingslot.game`, signed with your Godot debug keystore, full-screen.
- Turned on the ETC2/ASTC texture setting that Android export requires.
- Added a `build/` folder for the APK, which Godot ignores.

**What you should know:**
- **Balance:** on your tall screen the lane is longer, so enemies take more time to reach your squad. That makes waves a bit easier on the phone than on PC.
- **No app icon yet.** The export warns about it and Android shows a default icon. Give me a 512×512 PNG, or tell me to make one from the pack art.
- **Debug build only.** It's fine for testing on your phone. Publishing to the Play Store needs a release keystore and an AAB, which I can set up later.

Two problems. The first is a real UX confusion more than a code bug:

1. **"Got an Archer, then got asked to add to my wheel."** A spin *summons a unit into your squad*. The draft after a wave adds a symbol to the *reels*, so it can come up in future spins. They're different things, but nothing on screen says so. I'll make the draft show what's already on your reels ("On reels: x2") and a line summarising the reels' contents.
2. **Spins are all upside.** I'll add curse symbols that go into the reels:

| Curse | Effect |
|---|---|
| Trap | Every unit loses a share of its HP |
| Thief | Steals some of your gold |
| Ambush | Fast enemies charge your squad |

They follow the same match rule as everything else: a pair is 4× worse, three of a kind 9×. You start with 1 curse, and each new wave adds another. The draft gets a "Remove curse" button that costs gold.

	pick = [R + "bookPlace1.ogg", R + "bookPlace2.ogg"],

	win = [J + "Steel jingles/jingles_STEEL01.ogg"],
